parovi.en: “I hope no one minds if we dispense with this for now?” Orso tossed his circlet down, gold twinkling in a dusty shaft of spring sunlight as it spun around and around. “Damn thing chafes rather.” He rubbed at the sore spots it had left above his temples. There was a metaphor there somewhere. The burden of power, the weight of a crown. But his Closed Council had no doubt heard all that before.
parovi.hr: — Nadam se da nitko nema ništa protiv da ovo za sada odložimo? Orso ležerno baci svoj vijenac, dok mu je zlato svjetlucalo u prašnjavoj gredi proljetnog sunca vrteći se u Round. — Prokleta stvar prilično žulja. Protrlja bolna mjesta koja su mu ostala iznad sljepoočnica. Tu se negdje krila metafora. Teret moći, težina krunjenja. No njegovo ga je Tajno vijeće nesumnjivo već sve to slušalo.

parovi.en: “It would be folly,” said Bayaz, his attention already back on the gardens, “to obstruct the free operation of the market.”
parovi.hr: — Bila bi ludost — odbrusi Bajaz, a pažnja mu se već vratila na vrtove — ometati slobodno djelovanje tržišta.

parovi.en: “The job of your Closed Council,” said Glokta, “is to anticipate threats to Your Majesty before they become threats.”
parovi.hr: — Zadaća je vašeg Zatvorenog vijeća — reče Glokta — predvidjeti prijetnje Vašem Veličanstvu prije nego što doista to postanu.

parovi.en: Superior Lorsen lowered the letter, frowning at Vick over the rims of his eye-lenses. He looked like a man who had not smiled in some time. Perhaps ever.
parovi.hr: Viši inspektor Lorsen spusti pismo namrštivši se na Vik preko rubova svojih naočala. Izgledao je poput čovjeka koji se već dugo nije nasmiješio. Možda i nikada.

parovi.en: She got the sense that Lorsen had heard the same rumours she had, delivered in breathless whispers with a great deal of lurid detail. That Shenkt’s skills went beyond the mortal and touched the magical. That he was a sorcerer who had damned himself by eating the flesh of men. Here in Westport, where calls to prayer echoed hourly over the city and cut-price prophets declaimed on every corner, such ideas were somehow harder to dismiss.
parovi.hr: Stekla je dojam da je Lorsen načuo iste glasine koje i ona, izgovorene zadihanim šapatom i praćene mnoštvom morbidnih pojedinosti. Da Šenktove vještine nadilaze smrtničke i dotiču se čarobnjaštva. Da je on mračnjak koji se prokleo blagujući ljudsko meso. Ovdje u Vestportu, gdje su pozivi na molitvu odzvanjali gradom svakoga sata, a jeftini proroci propovijedali na svakom uglu, takve su se zamisli činile nekako teže odbacitljivima.

parovi.en: “With thanks to our distinguished patrons—the Lady Ardee and her daughter Lady Savine dan Glokta.” Curnsbick gave his usual showman’s flourish towards the box where Savine sat, but the clapping now was yet more subdued. Did she even hear a few tattletale whispers below? She’s not all she was, you know. Not one half of what she was…
parovi.hr: — Uz zahvalnost našim uglednim pokroviteljima — gospođi Ardi i njezinoj kćeri, gospođi Savin dan Glokta. Kurnsbik izvede svoju uobičajenu zabavljačku gestu prema loži u kojoj je Savin sjedila, ali pljesak je sada bio još suzdržaniji. Je li dolje doista čula nekoliko izdajničkih šaputanja? Nije ona više ono što je bila, znate. Ni upola ono što je nekad bila…

parovi.en: She squeezed her face into a smile, snapped out her fan and forced herself into the midst of the press with Zuri at her shoulder. Eyes turned in her direction, expressions harder than she was used to. Assessing, rather than admiring. Scornful, rather than envious. They used to crowd around her like pigs around the one trough in the farmyard. Now the most tempting morsels went elsewhere. Savine could scarcely see Selest dan Heugen through the swarm of gentlemen competing for her attention. Only a
parovi.hr: Gomila ju je podsjećala na mnoštvo u Valbeku kada su Razbijači dijelili hranu po sirotinjskoj četvrti. Nosili su svilu umjesto krpa, zaudarali su na parfem umjesto na ustajali znoj, stalna prijetnja bila je propast radije nego nasilje, no guranje i glad ostali su posve isti. Bilo je vrijeme kada se Savin u tom gmizavom metežu osjećala ugodno poput matice u košnici. Sada joj je cijelo tijelo trnulo od prohladne panike. Morala je ugušiti nagon da počne mlatiti laktovima i vrišteći pobjeći prema iz

parovi.en: But when she glanced up, Curnsbick was not even looking at her. He was staring across the busy foyer towards the door.
parovi.hr: No kad je podignula pogled, Kurnsbik je nije ni gledao. Ziljio je preko živahnog predvorja prema vratima.

parovi.en: Broad nudged his food around the plate with it. Just holding the damn thing made his hand hurt. Felt too delicate for his aching fingers. “You reach an age it’s hard to learn new ways, I reckon.”
parovi.hr: Brod je njome gurao hranu po tanjuru. Sama pomisao da drži tu prokletu stvar boljela ga je u ruci. Činila se nekako preosjetljivom za njegove napaćene prste. — Dođeš u godine kada je teško usvojiti nove navike, reklo bi se.

parovi.en: “Boast of?” Broad stared back, over the rims of his lenses, so Gaunt was just a sparkly blur in the lamplight. “Fuck, no. I wake up with the sweats. I cry, sometimes. In the quiet times. Don’t mind admitting it.”
parovi.hr: — Hvaliti? Brod ga pogleda ispod okvira svojih naočala, tako da mu je Gaunt u svjetlosti svjetiljke bio tek svjetlucava mrlja. — U pičku materinu, ne. Budim se obliven znojem. Zaplačem, ponekad. U trenucima tišine. Nije me sram to priznati.

parovi.en: “Your problem, Master Broad, is you confuse your best with your worst. I need work to continue on the canal first thing tomorrow. First thing. I need it open and making me money.” She snarled the last word, teeth bared, her fury setting his heart thumping. She was a head shorter than him. He’d have been shocked if she was half his weight. But she still scared him. Not because of what she might do. Because of what she might get him to do. “Now make it happen, there’s a darling.”
parovi.hr: — Vaš je problem, majstore Brod, što svoje najbolje miješate s najgorim. Zahtijevam da radovi na kanalu počnu sutra ujutro, odmah u zoru. Odmah. Želim da bude Otvoreno i da mi donosi novac. Iskezila je tu posljednju riječ, ogolivši zube, a njezin mu je bijes natjerao srce da poskoči. Bila je niža od njega za glavu. Iznenadilo bi ga da je imala i upola manje kilograma od njega. Pa ipak, i dalje ga je plašila. Ne zbog onoga što bi ona mogla učiniti. Nego zbog onoga na što bi ga mogla nagovoriti. —

parovi.en: “A man can take a lot, when he thinks he’s fighting the good fight. I know that.” Broad rubbed gently at his knuckles. “But seeing it done to your child? That’s something else.”
parovi.hr: — Čovjek može podnijeti mnogo toga kada misli da se bori za pravu stvar. Znam ja to. — Brod je nježno protrljao zglobove prstiju. — Ali kad vidiš da to rade tvom djetetu? To je već nešto posve drugo.

parovi.en: It had been a bad idea to bring him. Vick knew she was better off alone. A lesson learned fresh in the camps with every family member gone in the frozen ground. Her father, shivering, lips turned blue, shortened fingers turned black. Her mother, always asking what she’d done to deserve this, as though deserve had anything to do with it. All the sweat and pain it had taken to get that medicine for her sister. Turning up with the bottle gripped tight to find her stiff and cold under the threadbare
parovi.hr: „Tako uvjerljiv. Tako zarazan. Tako silno… koja je ono riječ… karizmatičan. Voljen onako kako mogu biti samo političari oslobođeni vlasti — a samim time i razočaranja. Pridobio je mnoge za svoj način gledanja na stvari. Strana Unije nema nikoga u njegovoj klasi. Sve je to nekako ukočeno. Ali onda, teško je, zar ne, strastveno zagovarati ono što već imaš? Tako dosadno. Dok je divna alternativa? Buket obećanja! Vreća puna snova! Veličanstven brod fantazija, netaknut sudarima sa stvarnim obavljanje

parovi.en: Glaward pushed out his bottom lip. “If it’s a weak enemy you’re after, I hear the Gurkish are obliging. The Empire’s broken into splinters. No Prophet. Priests and princes and chiefs and governors all fighting each other for control.”
parovi.hr: — A ljudi mrze Stirijce više nego ikad — reče Antaup. — Čujem da je Vestport pravi bure baruta. Jedna iskra i… puf. — Nasmiješi se od uha do uha glumeći eksploziju. — A tamošnje žene… — Još se šire osmjehnu oponašajući još veću.

parovi.en: “The Great Wolf only respects the boot across his neck! To disarm us? How can they be so blind? It’s not half a year since we were fighting for our lives, without a shred of help from those bastards!”
parovi.hr: — Jesam je odmorio, i boljelo je još više. Pa sam trenirao, i postalo je gore. Pa sam je opet odmorio, i to nije pomoglo. Ništa krvavo ne pomaže! Zatočen sam u toj jebenoj stvari!

parovi.en: “Axes!” he bellowed, and the spearmen split apart, pretty neat. Not too far from what they’d practised, which was quite the wonder under the circumstances. The best fighters Stour had given him came pouring through the gap, mail and shields and good axes smashing into the flatheads from uphill with a sound like hail on a tin roof.
parovi.hr: Klover ga uhvati za rame i čvrsto stisne. — Mirno. U takvom trenutku svatko pomišlja na bijeg, barem nakratko, a dovoljan je samo jedan da sve uvjeri kako je to najbolja ideja. Prije nego što se snađeš, love te po šumi umjesto da slaviš pobjedu. A Kloverova su koljena postala previše ukočena za lovljenje, a kamoli za to da bude lovina.

parovi.en: Platforms were scattered in front. Stages where men and women stood in robes, in rags, festooned with talismans and beads or brandishing books and staffs. Wailing in broken voices to little crescents of curious onlookers, tearing at the air with their hands, pointing skywards with clawing fingers, eyes popping with passion and certainty, promising salvation and threatening damnation. Each insisting all the rest were frauds, and they alone were the one with all the answers.
parovi.hr: — Vjerojatno. Trgnula je ruku i probila se kroz krcati prolaz za Shudrom i njegovim stražarima, uzevši pravac prema tržnici začina koja je u svojoj suludoj mjeri bila zasljepljujuća, zaglušujuća i zagušljiva poput valbečke tkaonice. Košare i bačve stajale su u klimavim kulama, police bijahu krcate blistavim staklenkama ulja. Boje su bile iznimno žive na sunčevu svjetlu, puderi jarko crvene, narančaste i žute boje, lišće u svakoj nijansi zelene i smeđe. Utezi i novčići zveckali su i zvrčali, mušk

parovi.en: Lady Wetterlant turned a glare on the high justice that might have frozen milk. “Mine is an old family, Your Majesty. We have many friends.”
parovi.hr: — Sedamnaest prokletih seljaka! Wetterlant u iznenadnom gnjevu zgrabi rešetke. — Uzeo bi njihovu riječ ispred moje?

parovi.en: “It is not an easy role to fill.” Bayaz reached out to touch that flower with his fingertip, ever so gently brushing a few specks of glittering dew from its petals. “Living kings are always objects of derision. But people cannot wait to worship the dead ones. Someone must lead. Someone must make the hard choices. For everyone’s benefit.”
parovi.hr: — Nije lako ispuniti tu ulogu. Bajaz posegnu kako bi vrhom prsta dotaknuo taj cvijet, sasvim nježno otresajući nekoliko iskričavih kapi rose s njegovih latica. „Živi su kraljevi uvijek predmet podsmijeha. No ljudi jedva čekaju obožavati mrtve. Netko mora voditi. Netko mora donijeti teške odluke. Za svačiju korist.”

parovi.en: “It has not been the happiest of marriages in recent years, then,” observed Orso, thinking of his father’s grinding teeth during their fencing sessions.
parovi.hr: — Onda to posljednjih godina i nije bio najsretniji brak, primijeti Orso, prisjećajući se kako su mu ocu škripali zubi tijekom njihovih mačevalačkih treninga.

parovi.en: “Most of them are every bit as disgusted at his behaviour as we are, Your Majesty. They are keen to see justice done.”
parovi.hr: — Većina njih zgrožena je njegovim ponašanjem baš kao i mi, Vaše Visočanstvo. Žarko žele vidjeti da je pravda zadovoljena.

parovi.en: “Very little worth anything is ever given away. I am sure you know that, too.” Bayaz smiled at Savine’s father. The one in the chair, not the one immortalised in stone. “I have no doubt your father will stand here one day. Who has sacrificed more for the Union, after all? Except perhaps your uncle.” Bayaz turned to look up at the statue of Lord Marshal West. “Who gave his life defending it.”
parovi.hr: — Vrlo se malo toga vrijednog ikada poklanja. Siguran sam da i vi to znate. — Flik se osmjehnu Savininom ocu. Onome u stolici, ne onome ovjekovječenom u kamenu. — Nemam nimalo sumnje da će vaš otac jednog dana stajati ovdje. tko je, uostalom, žrtvovao više za Uniju? Osim možda vašeg ujaka. — Flik se okrenu kako bi pogled usmjerio prema kipu lorda maršala Westa. — Koji je dao život braneći je.

parovi.en: “I’ve been made some outrageous proposals,” Savine threw over her shoulder to Zuri as she pulled off her gloves, “but that must be the first time a statue on the Kingsway has been put on the table…”
parovi.hr: — Dobivala sam već prilično nečuvene prijedloge, dobaci Savin preko ramena Zuri dok je skidala rukavice, ali ovo je zasigurno prvi put da je kip na Kingswayju stavljen na stol…

parovi.en: “It’ll be the event of the season,” said Savine’s mother, “though if you’re asking me, the man’s a bloody viper. Wine, Savine?”
parovi.hr: — Bit će to događaj sezone, dometnu Savinina majka, mada je, ako mene pitate, taj čovjek obična krvava guja. Vina, Savin?

parovi.en: “Don’t be cross and don’t be coy. Neither suits you. Zuri is worried for you, as a good servant should be. As a good friend should be. She is thinking of your best interests. We all are, believe it or not.” Her mother leaned forward, holding her eye, and put a reassuring hand on Savine’s knee. “She told us about your… situation.”
parovi.hr: „Nemoj se srditi i nemoj se pretvarati. Nijedno ti ne priliči. Zuri brine za tebe, kao što dobra služavka treba brinuti. Kao što dobar prijatelj treba brinuti. Ona misli na tvoje najbolje interese. Sve mi mislimo, vjerovala tomu ili ne.” Njezina majka se nagne naprijed, zadržavajući njezin pogled, te položi umirujuću ruku na Savinino koljeno. „Rekla nam je za tvoju… situaciju.”

parovi.en: “Congratulations on your forthcoming marriage.” Leo winced at a twinge in his leg as he broke free. “Haven’t seen my mother this excited in years.” He turned slowly around, looking up towards the gilded dome high, high above. “Doubt you could find a grander venue.”
parovi.hr: Krunski princ Orso činio mu se sasvim u redu, ali prijestolje samo pojačava čovjekove loše osobine, a njegovo Zatvoreno vijeće činili su isti oni korumpirani crvi koji su vladavinu kralja Džezal otjerali u jarak. Ono što je Uniji trebalo bili su ljudi od hrabrosti, ljudi od strasti, ljudi od akcije.

parovi.en: “Let me be your shepherdess. I can help you get your way.” By the dead, she was close now. “With the Closed Council. With my father. With the great men of the realm.” He could smell her. That sweetness, that heady sharpness. “I know everyone worth knowing. And how to use them.” Her scent brought all the excitement of that night rushing back.
parovi.hr: Na njegovo iznenađenje, ali nipošto razočaranje, njezina ruka nađe se među njegovim nogama. Već polukrut, i nije trebalo dugo da ga dovede do kraja. Činjenica da su bili na vidiku pola Agrionta, a majke im nisu bile ni deset koraka daleko, činila je sve to još uzbudljivijim.

parovi.en: A hand lifted her head, the rim of a cup pressed to her mouth. She coughed on something bitter, shuddered as she swallowed.
parovi.hr: Ruka joj podiže glavu, rub čašice prisloni se uz usta. Zakašlja se na nešto gorko, prestrašeno se strese dok je gutala.

parovi.en: “That they are,” said Scenn. The hillman stood grinning next to one of the Shanka and it narrowed its already narrow eyes at him while it used a splinter of bone to pick at one huge tooth. “They guard the witch. She can speak to ’em. Sings to ’em, some say. They’re tame. Long as we behave.”
parovi.hr: — Jesu, odvrati Skenn. Brđanin je stajao cerkajući se pored jednog Shanka, koji je suzio svoje ionako uske oči prema njemu dok je komadićem kosti čačkao ogroman zub. — Oni čuvaju vješticu. Ona može razgovarati s njima. Neki kažu da im pjeva. Pitomi su. Dok god se pristojno ponašamo.

parovi.en: “She has to go up there and that’s all there is to it,” snapped Isern, harshly. “This girl matters, Scenn. She’s beloved of the moon. I’ve always known it.”
parovi.hr: — Ona se mora popeti gore i to je sve — odbrusi Izern oštro. — Ova djevojka je važna, Skenne. Mjesec ju obožava. Oduvijek sam to znala.

parovi.en: Shivers gave Rikke a glance, but she was too out of breath to do much more than shrug. “How… do we get there… then?” she asked between her wheezes.
parovi.hr: Šivers uputi Rike pogled, ali ona je bila odviše zadihana da bi učinila išta više od slijeganja ramenima. — Kako… da se domognemo… toga onda? — upita kroz hropac.

parovi.en: “The cold has a wonderful way of clearing the mind.” Not the witchy croak Rikke had expected. A young voice, smooth and full of music. “It fixes you on what counts. Draws your attention inwards.”
parovi.hr: — Hladnoća ima čudesan način bistrenja uma. — Nije to bio vještičji hropac koji je Rike očekivala. Mladi glas, gladak i ispunjen glazbom. — Usmjerava te na ono što je važno. Privlači tvoju pozornost prema unutra.

parovi.en: The witch gave a hiss of disappointment. “It is the potter’s task to impose her will upon the clay. To shape the clay into something useful. Or something beautiful.”
parovi.hr: Vještica otpuhnu razočarano. „Zadatak je lončara nametnuti svoju volju glini. Oblikovati glinu u nešto korisno. Ili nešto lijepo.”

parovi.en: It was far from his first visit to the Lords’ Round, of course. He remembered being mildly bored when his father had shown it to him as a building site, rather impressed when his father had shown it to him largely completed, then exceedingly bored when his father had presided over the first meeting of the Open Council there.
parovi.hr: Ipak, to mu ni izdaleka nije bio prvi posjet Okrugloj vijećnici. Sjećao se da mu je bila donekle dosadna kad mu ju je otac pokazao dok je još bila gradilište, prilično impresivna kad mu ju je otac pokazao uglavnom dovršenu, a zatim iznimno dosadna kad je otac ondje predsjedavao prvom sjednicom Otvorenog vijeća.

parovi.en: A side door was flung open with an echoing bang. There was a rustling as lords and proxies twisted to see, people in both public galleries leaning out dangerously far in their eagerness to glimpse the prisoner. The hall fell quiet. There was a scraping, tapping, clinking sound, and Fedor dan Wetterlant emerged from the darkness.
parovi.hr: Bio je to trijumf, a nakon svih nedaća, preokreta, da i ne spominjemo užase opasne po život iz prethodnih nekoliko mjeseci, bio joj je prijeko potreban da si malo olakša dušu. Trebala se topiti u pažnji. Uživati u ljubomori svojih mnogobrojnih neprijatelja. Pustiti svijet da iza lepeze nazre barem nagovještaj njezina samodopadnog osmijeha.

parovi.en: Orso frowned up towards the public gallery, looking angrier than Savine had ever seen him. She shrank back from the rail, wondering whether her own history with the two men might be aggravating things. But the Young Lion was aggravating enough without her help.
parovi.hr: — Gubimo vrijeme?, prošaptao je Leo. Išer je podigao obrve i nemoćno raširio dlanove kao da želi reći: Što sam ti ja govorio? Iza njega, na jednom od velikih vitraja, Otvoreno vijeće ustalo je ujedinjeno protiv tiranije Luđaka Morlica, i to samo zato što je Arnault smogao hrabrosti stati prvi, sasvim sam.

parovi.en: They walked in silence, one of the wheels of Glokta’s chair catching on every turn with a regular squeak, squeak, squeak which might as well have been a saw applied directly to Orso’s nerves.
parovi.hr: — Ali… — Wetterlant odvrati pogled prema Išeru, kao da uopće nije očekivao takav ishod, no Išer prekriži ruke na prsima i ne pogleda nikoga u oči. — Ja sam član Otvorenog vijeća…

parovi.en: “And my heart.” Rikke wasn’t sure whether she’d meant to let go the string or not, but her arrow stuck into the lad’s back, just under his shoulder blade.
parovi.hr: — I moje srce. — Rike nije bila sigurna je li namjeravala pustiti tetivu ili ne, ali njezina strijela zabode se mladiću u leđa, neposredno ispod lopatice.

parovi.en: The bench had ropes around it. And on the polished-smooth cave floor salt had been scattered. Circles and lines and symbols in salt. Candles burning in the darkness. A joke of a witch’s cave.
parovi.hr: Klupa je bila opasana konopcima. A po uglađenom podu pećine bila je posuta sol. Krugovi i crte i simboli u soli. Svijeće su gorjele u tami. Izgledalo je kao sprdnja od vražje pećine.

parovi.en: By the Fates, her eyes were already brimming again, making her powder run. It can be pleasant to have someone weak leaning on you. It can make you feel strong. But there comes a point when they become a dead weight to carry. Savine was happy to play big sister but she drew the line at motherhood. She would have her own child to worry about soon enough.
parovi.hr: Savin nije bila ni približno sigurna je li čvrst karakter osobina koju mladoženje najviše cijene kod mladenke. Prihvatila je Isoldine mlohave ruke. — Ponašaj se kao da sve ide točno po tvom planu. Kao da si najsamouvjerenija osoba na svijetu. Kao da nikad u životu nisi imala ni trunku sumnje. — Savin je zabacila ramena, podigla bradu i okrenula se prema vratima. — Kod mene to pali.

parovi.en: And Orso snatched two glasses from a passing waiter’s tray and pressed one into Isher’s hand. “There’s as much need for cooperation between the Crown and Open Council as ever. More! I hope we can work together again to bring it about. This time… with a happier outcome?” Such as Isher’s neck in the noose rather than Wetterlant’s, for example. “To your happiness, my friend, and that of your charming bride, of course!”
parovi.hr: Orso bi radije bio bilo gdje drugdje. Tamnice gurkulskog cara u tom su mu trenutku zvučale privlačnije. Uostalom, teško je bilo zamisliti veću torturu od veličanstvenog vjenčanja žene koju je volio s mužem kojega definitivno nije podnosio, a među gostima se našla čitava lepeza podrugljivih neprijatelja koji su mu se u lice klanjali i ulagivali, a čim bi zamaknuo izvan dometa sluha, sipali prezir na njega.

parovi.en: “Dinner will be served shortly, Your Majesty.” A powdered footman gestured towards his chair—the largest chair, of course—in the very centre of the great polished horseshoe of table. He wondered how many trees had died to make it possible. “If it please Your Majesty, you are to be seated between the two brides, the grooms just without, to either side.” And he managed to back away and bow simultaneously.
parovi.hr: Leo bi joj se rado pridružio i uživao u svom dijelu divljenja. No nikada nije bio neki plesač, čak ni prije povrede noge. Malo koji vojnik jeste. Antaup, možda. Zapitao se što bi njegovi prijatelji rekli kad im predstavi svoju mladu. Ostali bi bez teksta, najvjerojatnije. Kako bi uopće mogli ostati ravnodušni? Kako bi to bilo tko mogao?

parovi.en: There was a long, expectant silence. The hairs on Leo’s neck prickled. A clock on the marble mantel tick, tock, ticked. He looked the three lords in the eye, one after another. Isher spoke far from plainly but, at the same time, left no doubt what they were discussing.
parovi.hr: Heugen ispusti uzdah negodovanja. Barezinovi podbratci zatreseše se u nijemom otporu. Išer odlučno odriješši bijelom glavom. „Mi bismo postupili u kraljevu najboljem interesu. U najboljem interesu zemlje.“

parovi.en: “They have been frustrated for years,” said Isher. “Chafing at the taxes, the infringements, the insults. Wetterlant’s treatment, and yours—a genuine hero of the Union, mark you, in our own Lords’ Round—was the final straw.”
parovi.hr: Leovo je srce zatreperilo na pomisao o stezanju oklopa. Mjesto mu je bilo na čelu redova raspjevanih vojnika, a ne izmučenom i pod papučom iza nekakvog prašnjavog, starog stola. Nasmiješio se pomislivši na marševske čizme, vjetar koji nosi zastave, zveket isukanog čelika, tutnjavu konjskih kopita u jurišu…

parovi.en: She shoved him. He didn’t even try to stay standing. Caught his head on an occasional table as he fell, bit his tongue and sprawled on his back, surrounded by scattered ornaments. Marshal Kroy stared down at him from the heavy frame. His feelings on the business were hard to judge.
parovi.hr: Gurnula ga je. Nije se ni pokušao održati na nogama. Udario je glavom o stolicu dok je padao, ugrizao se za jezik i srušio se na leđa, okružen razbacanim ukrasima. Maršal Kroy promatrao ga je s visine iz teškog okvira. Njegove dojmove o cijelom poslu bilo je teško procijeniti.

parovi.en: Gorst shook his head, eyes eternally roving around the dim room as though a Styrian assassin might spring from the dresser at any moment. If one had, Orso never doubted Gorst would have been ready with the utmost extremes of lethal force.
parovi.hr: Gorst odvrgnu glavu, očiju koje su neprekidno lutale po zagušljivoj prostoriji kao da bi štirski ubojica svakoga trena mogao skočiti iz ormara. Da jest, Orso ni na trenutak ne bi posumnjao da bi Gorst bio spreman uporabiti krajnje mjere smrtonosne sile.

parovi.en: “Reckless,” piped Gorst. Orso turned to him, surprised. It might have been the first time he’d ever heard the man volunteer a word of conversation. He shrugged, armour faintly rattling. “Kings needs cool tempers.” And he went back to frowning about the room.
parovi.hr: — Lakomislen, oglasi se Gorst. Orso se okrenu prema njemu, iznenađen. Možda je to bio prvi put da je čuo tog čovjeka kako dobrovoljno izusti riječ razgovora. On slegnu ramenima, a oklop mu slabašno zveknu. — Kraljevima treba hladna glava. I vrati se mrštenju po sobi.

parovi.en: “Morning, Your Grace,” said Savine as he sat opposite her at the breakfast table and gingerly stretched out his leg.
parovi.hr: „Jutro, Vaša Visosti”, odvrati Savin sjedajući nasuprot njemu za doručkovni stol te oprezno ispruži nogu.

parovi.en: “Bride is youthful,” said Carmee Groom, plucking out one of the pencils shoved through her shambolic bun and causing half of it to collapse across her face. “Bride bursts with potential.”
parovi.hr: — ! odbrusi ona, s bijelim zglobovima dok je stiskala rub stola. — Mjesto iskrenosti. Ako Svorbrik od govana može ispresti dijamante, samo naprijed. Kamo je, do đavola, stavila svoj prah od bisera?

parovi.en: But things had changed since she went to the forbidden lake, and not just ’cause she kept getting surprised on her right-hand side. The left was full of sad shocks, too. Folk she’d have called friends stared as she passed like they saw the dead walk, slunk off and wouldn’t meet her one good eye. Folk who used to smile looked scared, shocked, disgusted even. One woman Rikke had never been able to shut up about the weather herded her three children inside at the sight of her and slammed the door.
parovi.hr: No stvari su se promijenile otkad je posjetila zabranjeno jezero, i to ne samo zato što su je stalno s desne strane dočekivala iznenađenja. I s lijeve su je čekali tužni šokovi. Ljudi koje bi nekad nazivala prijateljima zurili bi u nju dok je prolazila kao da vide mrtvaca koji hoda, izmicali bi se i odbijali susresti se s njenim jedinim zdravim okom. Oni koji su se nekad smiješili djelovali su uplašeno, šokirano, štoviše zgroženo. Jedna žena s kojom Rike nikako nije uspjela prestati razglabati o

parovi.en: Lots of weapons in that hall, lots of sorrow and lots of anger, and Clover made sure he knew where all the doors were. When a great man dies, those left over always take a moment working out where their loyalties are most fruitfully laid, and there’s a high risk of bloodshed in the meantime. He’d seen one funeral turn into several often enough.
parovi.hr: Bilo je mnogo oružja u toj dvorani, mnogo tuge i mnogo gnjeva, a Klover se pobrinuo da dobro upamti gdje su svi izlazi. Kada velik čovjek umre, oni koji preostanu uvijek uzmu malo vremena da razmisle gdje će im lojalnost biti najplodonosnija, a u međuvremenu postoji velika opasnost od prolivanja krvi. Vidio je on to prečesto, kako se jedan sprovod pretvori u nekoliko njih.

parovi.en: Bit by bit, with shuffling feet and hanging heads, folk started to drift back to their lives. Bit by bit, the garden emptied. Rikke stood looking at the ground, wishing she could see through it. Wishing she could force the Long Eye open and see her father’s face again. But her eye stayed cold as the rain, and the sea, and the cold ground.
parovi.hr: — Jesam, zar ne? Caurib je bila u pravu. Moć Dugog Oka nije bila toliko u onome što vidiš, koliko u onome u što natjeraš ljude da povjeruju. Rike se nikada u životu nije osjećala moćno sve dok nije natjerala Staura i njegove ljude da pobjegnu glavom bez obzira samo svojim okom i svojim riječima. — Ali vratit će se, reče. — Kao vukovi što vrebaju tik iza vatre.

parovi.en: Alas, not everyone was so easily pleased. Mustred and Clensher advanced with weighty frowns the moment the gangplank clattered across from ship to quay. Short of diving into the brine, there was no escape.
parovi.hr: — Kakve li sretne slučajnosti! Kao da je išta što je Savin učinila bilo slučajno. Ona se još slađe osmjehne, pružajući obje ruke. — A vi morate biti Džurand, Leov stari prijatelj i suborac.

parovi.en: “… since savings must be made in order to satisfy the Closed Council,” gurgled out Clensher, sounding as if he had a sockful of gravel in his throat, “I move that we reduce Angland’s standing armies by two regiments, and—”
parovi.hr: — … budući da se uštede moraju ostvariti kako bi se zadovoljilo Zatvoreno vijeće, zagrgolja Clensher zvučeći kao da u grlu ima čarapu punu šljunka, predlažem da smanjimo anglandsku stajaću vojsku za dvije pukovnije, i —

parovi.en: Orso slumped further yet. “I never doubted I’d be a terrible king, but I never thought I’d be my father’s son so— ah!”
parovi.hr: Orso se još više pogrbio. — Nikad nisam sumnjao da ću biti užasan kralj, ali nikad nisam mislio da ću biti očev sin na ta — ah!

parovi.en: One of the nobles from the Open Council—Barezin, maybe—was on his feet and roaring his outrage but was entirely inaudible over the screeching commoners, who were pelting the scaffold with rotten food. There was a shriek, followed by another surge through the crowd but wilder, arms flailing. A fight breaking out and quickly spreading.
parovi.hr: Jedan od plemića iz Otvorenog vijeća — možda Barezin — ustao je i urlao od bijesa, ali se njegov glas uopće nije čuo od vike pučana koji su gnjusnom hranom zasipali vješala. Zaorio se prodoran krik, a potom je uslijedio još jedan nalet kroz gomilu, još divlji, s mlatarajućim rukama. Izbila je tuča i ubrzo se proširila.

parovi.en: She pulled the old sheepskin tight around her shoulders. Still smelled like him, somehow. She wished for a moment he could be woken, and thought of him striding in to see what all the fuss was about. Thought of him smiling at her the way he used to, like she was the most precious thing he had. The most precious thing there was. Then she wondered if he would smile, when he saw her blinded eye and the runes on her face. Wondered if he’d have stared, fearful and queasy like everyone else. The thoug
parovi.hr: Uz određenu dozu nevoljkosti, dvojica starih ratnih poglavica stadoše krugom obilaziti jedan drugoga; Crvenkapica s uzdignutim vrhom mača, a Oksel s mačem ispruženim u stranu. Kružili su sve bliže, Oksel ogoljenih zubi, a Crvenkapica vrškom jezika prelazeći preko donje usne. Kružili su još bliže, a onda Crvenkapica izbode, dok Oksel odbi udarac, uzvrati silovitim zamahom, a Crvenkapica izmače saginjanjem. Držači štitova zadihano uzdahnuše, a štitovi zaškripaše dok se Round napinjao i pomicao, a

parovi.en: “We can hope.” Though since Savine had been with child several months before her wedding it did not seem terribly likely. She kept the smile clamped to her face until Isold was gone, then she stood, pushed the heels of her hands into her aching back, and went straight to the connecting door. She had planned to sweep through and take her share of the conversation by force, but there was something secretive to Leo and Isher’s hushed tones that made her hold back. She ever so gently eased the door
parovi.hr: — Jesi. To se naprosto više nije moglo sakriti, a Savin je prilično uživala u tome što se vidi. Očekivala je da će je silno živcirati to što joj sebični mali parazit svakim danom sve više krade tijelo. No, u njezinu ispupčenom trbuhu bilo je nečeg neobično utješnog. Čak se povremeno zatekla kako mu pjeva. Onomad je osjetila kako se pomaknuo. Savin podiže obrve nježno ga milujući. „Tko bi rekao da je ključ sreće u široj odjeći? Kakve su prilike u Miderlandu?“ upita nastojeći zvučati ravnodušno. —

parovi.en: “I… was,” he said, frowning. He didn’t know where she was taking him but didn’t much like the direction of travel. “Thought I was doing right. I guess.” Hard to remember what he’d thought. Seemed like a different man who’d thought it.
parovi.hr: — Ja… jesam — reče namrštivši se. Nije znao kamo ga vodi, ali mu se smjer puta nije odviše sviđao. — Mislio sam da postupam ispravno. Valjda. — Teško se bilo prisjetiti što je točno mislio. Činilo se kao da je te misli imao netko sasvim drugi.

parovi.en: Rikke stuck her fingertip in her milky right eye. “This eye fought the other, so it had to go. My visions come much cleaner now.” She leaned close and muttered it out of the corner of her mouth, “Don’t shit myself no more neither. And I’m still me!” She punched him on the arm. Good-natured, but hard. “More or less.”
parovi.hr: Potjera konja naprijed, kroz skupinu novih koliba i kuća, ostavljajući Antaupa, Jina i ostale iza sebe s kočijom i zapregama. Savin je držala korak s njime, prošavši kroz vrata i truckajući se popločanim putem, dok su ih prljava lica u bezbojnoj odjeći u čudu promatrala dok su prolazili. Mnogo se toga promijenilo. Možda nove građevine ondje gdje je Staur Najtfol spalio stare. Veličanstvenije građevine, od kamena i škriljevca umjesto od drva i pletera.

parovi.en: “I tend somewhat to agree. No reason you and I can’t be good neighbours, though. Why don’t you come inside? I’ll toss a fresh log on the firepit and crack a keg of my father’s ale.”
parovi.hr: — Isto mislim i ja, dometnu Rike namještajući iza uha pramen kose koji joj je slani povjetarac otpuhao s lica. — Što te dovodi ovamo, Nokte?

parovi.en: We all are carried into the future, always. What greets us when we arrive, that is the pressing question. When the Prophet vanished, Muslan and those of his mind—the thinkers, philosophers, engineers—had hoped for a new age of reason. Instead had come an age of madness. The priests had said his work was against the laws of God. Ignorant cowards. Who made the minds of men, if not God? What was the desire to create, if not a humble imitation of His example? What was the grand idea, the great visio
parovi.hr: Svi smo mi uvijek nošeni u budućnost. Što nas dočekuje kad stignemo, to je goruće pitanje. Kad je Poslanik iščeznuo, Muslan i oni slična uma — mislioci, filozofi, inženjeri — nadali su se novom dobu razuma. Umjesto toga stiglo je doba ludila. Svećenici su govorili da je njegov rad protivan Božjim zakonima. Neuki kukavice. Tko je stvorio ljudske umove, ako ne Bog? Što je bila žudnja za stvaranjem, ako ne ponizno oponašanje Njegova primjera? Što je bila uzvišena ideja, velika vizija, duboko otkrov

parovi.en: Orso stood staring for what felt like a very long time, one hand weakly holding his mother’s limp arm, his sword dangling uselessly from the other. He would have dropped it had his fingers not been stuck in the elaborate basketwork. The first of the attackers lay on his side at their feet, the cloth twisted from his stubbly face, a steadily widening pool of blood bubbling from his nose and mouth.
parovi.hr: Gdje su bili vitezovi Tjelesne straže? Zar nisu trebali rješavati takve stvari? Ta to je bila jedina svrha tih kopiladi, zar ne? Ugledao je jednoga mrtvog, s komadom metala probodenim kroz oklop na prsima. Stoga mu se nije moglo previše prigovoriti. Gdje je bio Bremer dan Gorst? Dao mu je slobodan dan. Inzistirao je na tome. Grozna odluka. Je li Orso donio ijednu dobru? Nije se mogao sjetiti se nijedne. Vjerojatno je krivica bila njegova. Obično i jest bila. Kralj je bio tek svojevrsna kanta u k

parovi.en: “The Young Lion!” Stour rose from Skarling’s Chair. “Not as young as you were, but no worse for that.” He caught Brock’s hand, and pulled him up onto the dais, and flung his other arm around his shoulders, and slapped him on the back with an echoing clap. Then the two of ’em had one of those hugs which is halfway to a wrestling match, making out they were best of friends while each tried to drag the other off his feet.
parovi.hr: Brok to prevede na jezik Unije svojoj ženi, a ona se nasmija jednako blistavo kao što joj je haljina sjajila. Klover se zapita koliko je vježbala da bi taj smijeh zvučao savršeno, ali se istodobno silno obradova saznanju da je on bio uzrok tomu, a onda se silno razočara kad ona produži dalje. Daunsajd je blenuo za njom poput lisice u otvoreni kokošinjac.

parovi.en: She could usually slit a man right open with one compliment, but Black Calder was better armoured than most. “My own father always said it serves a man well to learn the ways of his enemies,” he grunted.
parovi.hr: Obično je mogla rasparati čovjeka jednim jedinim komplimentom, no Blek Kalder bio je bolje oklopljen od većine. — Moj mi je otac uvijek govorio da čovjeku koristi upoznati običaje svojih neprijatelja, odbrusio je on.

parovi.en: Sad to say, Stour didn’t slit his hand and swear a blood oath to their alliance on the spot. Instead, he sat back, toying with his ale cup.
parovi.hr: Nažalost, Staur ne rasiječe dlan i ne zakle se na krvni Unija za njihovo savezništvo na licu mjesta. Umjesto toga se zavalio, poigravajući se vrčem aleja.

parovi.en: But all Stour gave Leo was another dose of the side-eye. “Once you’ve heard one song of victory you’ve heard ’em all. Swap the names out and it’s the same spears shaken and horns blown and bodies carpeting the glen and all that shit. You see my friend Clover down there?” And he pointed out that balding bastard, the one who’d had the girl beside him with all the belts. “That fat fool used to be Jonas Steepfield.”
parovi.hr: No sve što je Staur udijelio Leu bila je još jedan prijeki pogled ispod oka. — Kad čuješ jednu pjesmu o pobjedi, čuo si ih sve. Samo zamijeni imena i to je to — ista priča o zveckanju koplja, puhanju u rogove, tijelima koja prekrivaju dolinu i sva ta sranja. Vidiš li mog prijatelja Klovera tamo dolje? Pokazao je na onog ćelavog kopilana, onog s djevojkom do sebe koja je bila okićena remenjem. — Taj debeli idiot nekada je bio Jonas Strmograd.

parovi.en: “It might.” To her, at least. For him, there was no help. His Majesty’s Inquisition tended away from leniency when it came to attempted regicide. “Who planned it?”
parovi.hr: — Svi to govore. No možda su nešto propustili. Možda si ti nešto propustio. Nešto čega nisi bio ni svjestan da je važno.

parovi.en: She pulled the door shut and clipped his voice back to a muffled burble. A Practical stood outside, arms folded.
parovi.hr: Privukla je vrata i prigušila mu glas u prigušeno mumljanje. Inkvizitorov čovjek stajao je vani, prekrštenih ruku.

parovi.en: “Besides, we have no evidence. The one thing I’m sure Leo dan Brock is guilty of is finding me contemptible. If that’s a crime, I’ll have to hang three-quarters of the country. Have you seen the latest pamphlets? About me? About my mother? About the debt?”
parovi.hr: — Osim toga, nemamo dokaza. Jedina stvar za koju sam siguran da je Leo dan Brok kriv jest to što me prezire. Ako je to zločin, morat ću objesiti tri četvrtine zemlje. Jeste li vidjeli najnovije pamflete? O meni? O mojoj majci? O dugu?

parovi.en: “At last!” The barman’s accent was a strange cocktail—a slosh of Styrian and a dash of the Union with a few more ingredients which were harder to place. Tall and pale, with spiky red hair and a spiky red beard. He had a white cloth over one shoulder and a little monkey squatting on the other and he smiled a wide smile full of good teeth. “Victarine dan Teufel graces my humble establishment.”
parovi.hr: — Napokon! Barmenov naglasak bio je čudan koktel — mješavina štirijskog i primjese Unije s još nekoliko sastojaka koje je bilo teže odrediti. Visok i blijed, s usiljenom crvenom kosom i usiljenom crvenom bradom. Preko jednog ramena nosio je bijelu krpu, a na drugome mu je čučao mali majmun te se široko nasmiješio otkrivši niz zdravih zuba. — Viktarin dan Tojfel, počasti moju skromnu ustanovu.

parovi.en: He trudged down a slum street not far from where he’d once lived, the way just rutted dirt and ashes and rubbish flung out from the houses, dark from the buildings leaning together and the washing flapping in the gritty breeze. There were no drains, only pools of flyblown filth, fenced off in places to make pens for the squealing hogs, their run-off leaking through the slit windows into the cellars where the poorest eked out some kind of a living.
parovi.hr: Teško je koračao ulicom u sirotinjskoj četvrti, nedaleko od mjesta gdje je nekada živio; put je bio tek izlokana zemlja pomiješana s pepelom i smećem izbačenim iz kuća, zamračen zgradama koje su se naginjale jedna prema drugoj i rubljem što je lepršalo na prašnjavom vjetru. Odvoda nije bilo, samo lokve prljavštine pune muha, mjestimično ograđene kako bi se napravili torovi za cvileće svinje, čiji se otpad cijedio kroz uske prozore u podrume gdje su najsiromašniji jedva sastavljali kraj s krajem.

parovi.en: “I can take you to ’em.” Sarlby slowly chewed, slowly swallowed, slowly sat back. “But what happens after ain’t up to me.”
parovi.hr: — Pokušao sam na tvoj način — reče Brod. Namjestio je naočale na znojni nos i prisilio se disati polako. — Gledaj kamo nas je to dovelo.

parovi.en: Now the violinist had seen them, prancing over to the bridge just below their balcony, grinning up and hacking out a jauntier, more marshal theme. Beside the winery, two fellows started up a noisy argument. Typical Styrians, all swagger and no action.
parovi.hr: Sada ih je ugledao violinist, poskakujući prema mostu točno ispod njihova balkona, cereći se gore i izvodeći življu, ratoborniju melodiju. Pokraj vinarije dvojica su započela bučnu svađu. Tipični Štajerci, sve od hvalisanja, a nigdje djela.

parovi.en: He noticed there were grey streaks in her hair. Wrinkles around her eyes, at the corners of her mouth. When had she started to look old? It made him feel deeply uneasy. He had always supposed she was indestructible.
parovi.hr: Primijetio je sive pramenove u njezinoj kosi. Bore oko očiju, u uglovima usta. Kada li je to počela stariti? Zbog toga ga obuze duboka nelagoda. Uvijek je mislio da je ona neuništiva.

parovi.en: “Don’t worry.” Jurand, slipping up close to speak softly. Knowing Leo’s feelings without a word said, like always. He guided Leo over to the dice table. It was the right height to lean on, at least, and take the weight off his throbbing leg without showing any weakness. “You’re the Young Lion! You convinced Rikke and Stour to join you. United two bitter enemies under your banner! Just be honest, and strong, and generous. Just be you.” Jurand leaned closer, grinning. “Only a bit more ruthless. Th
parovi.hr: „Sve.“ Domaćin ih uvede u dvoranu tamnih drvenih obloga u kojoj su se igrale igre vještine, sreće i propasti. Skupine muškaraca sjedile su razgovarajući, smijući se, pušeći i pijući. Djevojke su gugutale, pjevušile i mahale lepezama. Šareno svjetlo blistalo je na finom staklu i mekoj koži, probijajući se kroz jantarna pića i kovitlac dima.
