Then he felt disgusted with himself for offering as much as he had, annoyed with Savine for making him try, irritated at the world and everything in it. He’d made a grubby compromise too far by even talking to that greasy bastard and hadn’t gained a thing. What use could a man like that be in a battle anyway? If you could even call him a
parovi.hr: Orso duboko uzdahne. — Ako sam bio spreman zabiti vlastitoj sestri nož u leđa, kako bi mi uopće mogao vjerovati? Kako bi bilo tko mogao? Mogao bih slagati i reći da hoću, a onda kasnije prekršiti riječ, ali mislim da nam je svima dosta takvog ponašanja. Radije ću biti pošten i reći da je najbolje što od mene možeš dobiti to da stvari ostanu ugodno poznate. Odreći ću se svojih prava na Talini. Taj sam grad vidio samo na slikama. Uzmi ga s mojim blagoslovom. Možda s vremenom uspijemo čak pružiti j

parovi.en: Glokta gave a little snort of laughter. “Only promise me one thing. Should you think me worthy of a statue on the Kingsway… have it stand up.” He waved a finger towards the Practical lurking behind him, and the man turned his wheeled chair towards the door.
parovi.hr: — Ne vidim razloga da to imenovanje ne učinimo trajnim, reče Orso. Možda će Bajaz imati drugačije ideje kad sljedeći put navrati, ali za sada će mali ljudi morati sami praviti svoje pogreške.

parovi.en: “Your Majesty.” Forest made to put his hat on, then stopped. “Bloody thing does look like a quim.” And he strode away.
parovi.hr: — Vaše Visočanstvo. Forest se spremi staviti kapu, pa zastane. — Prokleta stvar stvarno sliči na pičku. I odmaršira dalje.

parovi.en: “You…” Matstringer looked like he might swallow his tongue. “This is an unprecedented breach of protocol—”
parovi.hr: — Ti… — Matstringer je izgledao kao da će progutati vlastiti jezik. — Ovo je kršenje protokola bez presedana…

parovi.en: “Go to your departments,” said Orso, “and make preparations. I want our defences shored up. I want forces on high alert. I want anything disloyal rooted out.” He stood, planting his hands on the table. “You are the only ones I can trust. My father’s faithful advisors. My loyal Closed Council. If we stay together, we will yet weather this storm.”
parovi.hr: — Idite u svoje urede, zapovjedi Orso, i pripremite se. Želim da nam se obrana učvrsti. Želim snage u visokom stupnju pripravnosti. Želim da se svaka neposlušnost iščupa iz korijena. On ustane oslonivši se dlanovima o stol. — Vi ste jedini kojima mogu vjerovati. Vjerni savjetnici moga oca. Moje odano Zatvoreno vijeće. Ako ostanemo zajedno, prebrodit ćemo ovu oluju.

parovi.en: Maybe that thought put a bit more venom in her next slap, hard enough to get his mouth bleeding. “You’ve given me no time to be subtle,” she hissed at him, “so this is going to get very painful very fast.” She slapped him again, even harder, her fingers stinging and blood speckling the wall beside his face. “Give me names.”
parovi.hr: Možda joj je ta pomisao unijela još malo otrova u sljedeći šamar, dovoljno snažan da mu natjera krv na usta. — Nisi mi ostavio vremena za suptilnost, prosikta mu u lice, tako da će ovo postati jako bolno i jako brzo. Opet ga ošamari, još jače, dok su je prsti pekli, a krv prskala po zidu pokraj njegova lica. — Daj mi imena.

parovi.en: “Why do you think I did it? We’re supposed to be a Union!” He roared the last word with sudden anger, clenching his one fist, and Vick stepped back, watchful. She reckoned him far more dangerous than Heugen, however many limbs he was missing.
parovi.hr: — Zašto misliš da sam to učinio? Trebali bismo biti Unija! Urliknuo je posljednju riječ s iznenadnim gnjevom, stisnuvši svoju jedinu šaku, a Vik odskoči natrag, na oprezu. Smatrala ga je daleko opasnijim od Heugena, bez obzira na to koliko mu je udova nedostajalo.

parovi.en: “I am leaving Adua today,” said Glokta. “My wife thinks the country air may be good for my health. That is… what she tells me she thinks, anyway. I suspect she does not want us to become sad ghosts haunting the halls where we were once powerful. I suspect she is wise in this, as in so much else.” He cleared his throat. “Before I left, I wanted to thank you.”
parovi.hr: — Danas napuštam Aduu, reče Glokta. — Moja žena smatra kako bi seoski zrak mogao dobro djelovati na moje zdravlje. Barem… tako mi govori da misli. Sumnjam da želi bismo postali tužni duhovi koji opsjedaju dvorane u kojima smo nekad bili moćni. Sumnjam da je mudra u tome, kao i u toliko toga drugog. On pročisti grlo. — Prije nego što odem, htio sam ti zahvaliti.

parovi.en: “It would have been easy to give in to sentimentality,” said Glokta. “But you did the brave thing. The right thing. Turning him in. Buying your freedom.”
parovi.hr: — Bilo bi lako prepustiti se osjećajima, reče Glokta. — Ali ti si učinila hrabru stvar. Ispravnu stvar. Prijavila si ga. Kupila svoju slobodu.

parovi.en: The fear sharpened, and the excitement underneath it, creeping up his throat as lamplight glimmered on the rotten tree stumps, gleamed on the puddles in the road, caught the sharpened logs of the collapsing fence and the long shed with its fallen-in roof.
parovi.hr: Strah se izoštrio, a s njime i potmulo uzbuđenje koje mu se penjalo uz grlo dok je svjetlost svjetiljki titrala po trulim panjevima, blistala na lokvama na cesti i obasjavala zašiljene trupce srušene ograde te dugačku šupu urušenog krova.

parovi.en: Broad was already running. Towards the lamplight, the plunging horses, the swelling cloud of smoke. Pounding across the clearing for the road and the sawmill, the black world bouncing, the quick breath hissing through his gritted teeth, the eagerness boiling up his throat, setting him on fire.
parovi.hr: Brod je već trčao. Prema svjetlosti fenjera, propinjućim konjima, nabujalom oblaku dima. Lupajući preko čistine prema cesti i pilani, dok mu se Black svijet tresao pred očima, ubrzani dah sukljao je kroz stisnute zube, a žudnja mu se penjala grlom i palila ga iznutra.

parovi.en: Had a feeling two writhing shadows was one man stabbing another but he’d no idea who was who. There were no sides. Only those doing the killing and those getting killed.
parovi.hr: Imao je osjećaj da su dvije isprepletene sjene jedan čovjek koji bode drugoga, ali pojma nije imao tko je tko. Nije bilo strana. Bilo je samo onih koji ubijaju i onih koji ginu.

parovi.en: “Thought it was prisoners,” grunted Broad, frowning at him. “Off to Valbeck to be hanged, you said.”
parovi.hr: — Mislio sam da su zarobljenici, prosiktao je Brod mršteći se na nj. — Rekao si, pravac Valbek i vješala.

parovi.en: “For what?” said Judge, laughter in her voice. “The House o’ the Maker to open and great Euz to spring forth wreathed in fire? ’Cause that’s what it’ll take to stop this.” Sarlby finally tore the case free, braced his feet against the stump and dragged the manager’s arm across it by the chain while two other Burners held him, the bracelet cutting white into his wrist. A third raised a lamp high so no one missed anything, his eager grin lit from above.
parovi.hr: — Zašto? upita Džadž, s podsmijehom u glasu. — Da se Stvoriteljeva kuća otvori i veliki Euz pomoli u plamenu? Jer jedino bi to moglo ovo zaustaviti. Sarlbi naposljetku istrgne kovčežić, upre nogama o panj i prevuče upraviteljevu ruku preko njega držeći je za lanac, dok su je dvojica drugih Spaljivača držala, a narukvica se urezivala u bijelu kožu na zglobu. Treći visoko podigne svjetiljku da nitko ništa ne propusti, a željno mu se lice odozgo žarilo u osmijehu.

parovi.en: Sarlby tossed the hand away and shook the contents of the case onto the muddy ground. “Just papers,” he grunted, holding up a sheaf of documents. Judge started leafing through them by the flickering light of one of the fires.
parovi.hr: Sarlbi baci šaku i istrese sadržaj kovčežića na blatnjavo tlo. — Samo papiri, prozbori promuklo podižući snop dokumenata. Džadž ih je počela listati na treperavoj svjetlosti jedne od vatri.

parovi.en: As dawn broke, the army of Angland filed through Ostenhorm towards the quay, where just about every vessel in the province had been pressed into service as a transport, the harbour made a shifting thicket by their masts. Drums thumped, pipes tooted, sergeants bellowed, boots tramp, tramp, tramped. The salt breeze caught flags stitched with old victories, the rising sun gleamed on gear newly forged in Savine’s own armouries.
parovi.hr: Kako je zora svitala, anglandska je vojska koračajući prolazila kroz Ostenhorm prema pristaništu, kamo je gotovo svako plovilo u provinciji bilo rekvirirano kao transportno, a njihovi su jarboli od luke činili gustu, pomičnu šumu. Bubnjevi su tutnjali, svirale su piskutale, narednici urlički izdavali zapovijedi, a čizme su marširale u monotonom ritmu. Slani je povjetarac nosio zastave izvezene starim pobjedama, dok je izlazeće sunce sjalo na opremi tek iskovanoj u Savinim vlastitim oružarnicama.

parovi.en: “Leo, I’ve heard a rumour…” She said the words in a horrified whisper. “That you mean to move against the Closed Council.” She gave a desperate, quivery smile. “Tell me it’s not true!”
parovi.hr: — Leo, čula sam glasine… Izgovorila je te riječi užasnutim šapatom. „Da namjeravaš krenuti protiv Zatvorenog vijeća.” Uputila mu je očajan, drhtav osmijeh. — Reci mi da to nije istina!

parovi.en: Finree stared from him to Savine. She looked so utterly distraught that it was hard to meet her eye. “Have you thought about what you’re risking? Have you thought about what happens if you lose?”
parovi.hr: Finri ga je pogledala pa prešla pogledom na Savin. Izgledala je toliko potreseno da ju je bilo teško pogledati u oči. „Jesi li pomislila na ono što riskiraš? Jesi li pomislila što će biti ako izgubiš?”

parovi.en: Isern propped her hands on her own hips, such as they were. “I’m the way the moon wants me and naught wrong about it from where I stand.”
parovi.hr: Izern stavi ruke na vlastite bokove, kakvi već bijahu. — Ja sam onakva kakva me mjesec stvorio i nema ništa loše u tome s moje točke gledišta.

parovi.en: “Fought all his life so we could choose our own way. But here we are, still stuck ’twixt the Union and the North. It’s like we’ve a foot on either boat, but now the two are going different ways on the current, and if we don’t jump to one or the other we’re apt to get torn in two.” She grimaced and grabbed her crotch. “And in the most sensitive spot!” More laughter at that. Make ’em laugh, you’re halfway there, her father always told her.
parovi.hr: — Borio se cijelog života da bismo sami mogli birati svoj put. Ali evo nas, još uvijek zaglavljenih između Unije i Sjevera. Kao da stojimo jednom nogom na jednome, a drugom na drugome čamcu, ali sad ta dva čamca plove u različitim smjerovima na struji, i ako ne skočimo na jedan ili drugi, lako bismo se mogli raspoloviti. Siktavo se nasmiješila i uhvatila se za međunožje. — I to na najosjetljivijem mjestu! Još smijeha na to. Nasmjasi ih, pa si obavio pola posla, govorio joj je otac uvijek.

parovi.en: “No.” Clover didn’t bother to say that men usually fight harder on their own ground. He doubted Stour wanted to hear that, either.
parovi.hr: — Ne. Klover se nije trudio reći da se ljudi obično bore žešće na vlastitom tlu. Sumnjao je da i to Staur želi čuti.

parovi.en: “I said don’t land yourself in his debt. I didn’t say spit in his eye.” Calder shook his head grimly. “You don’t understand what he is.”
parovi.hr: — Rekao sam da mu ne ostaješ dužan. Nisam rekao da mu pljuneš u lice. Kalder odbrusi smrknuto. „Ti ne shvaćaš što on jest.”

parovi.en: Clover had his doubts on that score. He’d seen victories enough, and they were like the false summits of a great fell. You struggle towards ’em, sure you’ve made the top, then the moment you get there you see another just beyond. No fight was ever the last. No victory was ever for good. But Black Calder was getting old. He wanted to see his great legacy secured before he went back to the mud. Then he could trick himself into believing it wouldn’t crumble a few moments after.
parovi.hr: Klover je imao sumnji u tom smislu. Vidio je dovoljno pobjeda, a one su bile nalik lažnim vrhovima golemih planina. Mučiš se penjući se prema njima, uvjeren da si stigao na vrh, a onda u trenutku kad dospiješ ondje ugledaš novi, odmah iza njega. Nijedna borba nije bila posljednja. Nijedna pobjeda nije bila zauvijek. Ali Blek Kalder je stario. Želio je da mu velika ostavština bude osigurana prije nego što se vrati u blato. Tada bi mogao zavarati samoga sebe povjerovavši kako se sve neće srušiti n

parovi.en: “That is enough!” shouted Orso. “Forest, Pike, Tunny, Teufel and Hoff, stay. The rest of you out.” He would not have minded ejecting a couple of those named, but he supposed he needed all the help he could get. “Gorst, make sure we are not disturbed.”
parovi.hr: — To je dosta! — uzviknu Orso. — Forest, Pajk, Tani, Tojfel i Hof, ostanite. Ostali, vani. — Ne bi mu smetalo izbaciti i nekolicinu s tog popisa, ali pretpostavljao je da mu treba sva moguća pomoć. — Gorst, pobrini se da nas nitko ne ometa.

parovi.en: It wasn’t the most glorious stretch of shore, he had to admit, as his flooded boots finally crunched up onto the beach and he stood to rest his aching leg. A great grey curve of cold shingle, then a great yellow curve of wind-torn grass, then brown dunes and scrubby trees swept sideways, a few lonely birds hovering on the breeze the only sign of life. No cheering crowds waiting to celebrate their liberation from the tyranny of the Closed Council.
parovi.hr: Morao je priznati da to nije bio najslavniji komad obale, dok su mu promočene čizme naposljetku zašuštale po plaži i dok je zastao da odmori bolnu nogu. Veliki sivi Arch hladnog šljunka, zatim veliki žuti Arch vjetrom iščupane trave, pa smeđe dine i zakržljalo drveće pometeno u stranu, uz nekoliko usamljenih ptica koje su lebdjele na povjetarcu kao jedini znak života. Nikakve navijačke gomile nisu čekale da proslave oslobođenje od tiranije Zatvorenog vijeća.

parovi.en: Leo’s standard was unfurled above him, the crossed hammers and the lion, holed and torn from victories in the North but never taken by an enemy. He smiled up as the sea wind made it flap and flutter, setting his doubts to rest and his heart leaping.
parovi.hr: Leova se zastava vijorila iznad njega — ukriženi čekići i lav, izrešetani i poderani u sjevernim pobjedama, ali nikada pokoreni od neprijatelja. Podignuo je pogled s osmijehom dok ju je morski vjetar razvijao i tresao, rasteretivši mu sumnje i natjeravši srce da poskoči.

parovi.en: They picked their way around the boggy margins of a vast puddle in the road. One could have described it as a lake without fear of contradiction, men squatting on an upended cart at one side like shipwrecked mariners, all manner of gear floating on the rain-pricked water while others waded past, weapons over their heads, or tried to force their way through the hedges to either side.
parovi.hr: Zaobišli su močvarne rubove golemih lokvi na cesti. Netko ju je mogao opisati i kao jezero bez straha da će ga tko opovrgnuti, a ljudi suučesnički čučali na preokrenutim kolima s one strane poput brodolomaca, dok je najrazličitija oprema plutala po vodom našaranom kišnim kapima, a drugi gacali uokolo držeći oružje iznad glava ili pokušavali pronaći prolaz kroz živicu s jedne ili druge strane.

parovi.en: Isher’s unhappy horse kept trying to turn around. Savine sympathised. He bad-temperedly jerked it back. “You haven’t heard from him?”
parovi.hr: Išerov se uznemireni konj neprestano pokušavao okrenuti. Savin ga je savršeno razumjela. Išer ga je živčano trgnuo natrag. — Zar niste čuli ništa od njega?

parovi.en: “Hardbread!” said Leo, grabbing the old warrior by the hand and giving it a shake fit to tear his arm off. “At last! Where’s Rikke?”
parovi.hr: — Hardbred! reče Leo, zgrabivši starog ratnika za ruku i protrestavši je tako snažno da mu je umalo otkinuo ruku. — Napokon! Gdje je Rike?

parovi.en: The door rattled at a thudding knock, and she gritted her teeth and worked her way into a slightly more presentable position, bladder aching again already. “Yes?”
parovi.hr: Vrata zatreperiše pod tucajućim udarcem, a ona stisnu zube i namjesti se u nešto pristojniji položaj, dok ju je mjehur već ponovno mučio. — Molim?

parovi.en: The corporal barely looked up from his sizzling pan, just waved her on. One of the soldiers gave her a weak smile, then went back to scraping mud from a boot. None of them challenged her as she nudged her horse past, but that was no surprise.
parovi.hr: Desetar jedva da je podigao pogled s tave koja je cvrčala, tek joj mahnuo da prođe. Jedan joj se vojnik blago osmjehnuo, a zatim se vratio struganju blata s čizme. Nitko je nije zaustavio dok je poticala konja naprijed, ali to joj nije bilo iznenađenje.

parovi.en: “On your side.” She leaned down, glancing left and right, using an urgent whisper, as if she’d picked him and only him to trust with a secret. “And I have a message from Lord Marshal Brint that could change everything.”
parovi.hr: — Na vašoj strani. Nagnula se niže, osvrnuvši se lijevo i desno, i progovorila žurnim šapatom, kao da je izabrala upravo njega i nikoga drugog da mu povjeri tajnu. „A imam i poruku od lorda maršala Brinta koja bi mogla promijeniti sve.”

parovi.en: “Everyone’s loyalties are a touch tangled these days.” She hooked out the chair at the head of the table with her foot and dropped into it, meeting Savine’s eye. “I like to think I never let your father down. He got me out of the camps. I owed him. But he’s gone now.”
parovi.hr: — Svačija su odanost današnja vremena malo zamrsila. Nogom je privukla stolac s čela stola i sručila se na nj, susrevši Savinin pogled. — Volim misliti da nikada nisam iznevjerila tvog oca. Izvukao me iz logora. Bila sam mu dužna. No njega više nema.

parovi.en: Worse than she’d feared. The rebels might outnumber the loyalists two to one. She smiled as though it was better than she’d hoped. “You might outnumber him four to one.”
parovi.hr: Gore nego što se pribojavala. Pobunjenici bi mogli nadjačati lojaliste dva naprema jedan. Nasmiješila se kao da je to bolje nego što se nadala. — Možda ih nadjačavate četiri naprema jedan.

parovi.en: Prettyboy must’ve been named by a real wag since he was, by any standard, a thoroughly ugly man. “Just pointed the bow,” he said, shifting awkwardly on his knees. Everything’s awkward when your hands are tied to your ankles, to be fair. The bow in question lay in the mud not far away, and he gave it a filthy look like it was to blame for the whole business. “But I fumbled the string, you know, and shot him.”
parovi.hr: Prettyboya je morao nazvati neki golemi šaljivdžija budući da je bio, po svim mjerilima, temeljito ružan čovjek. — Samo sam usmjerio Arch, reče vrpoljeći se nespretno na koljenima. Sve je nespretno kad su ti ruke svezane za gležnjeve, ruku na srce. Predmetni Arch ležao je u blatu nedaleko od njega, a on ga je prostrijelio mrkim pogledom kao da je on kriv za cijelu tu gungulu. — Ali omakla mi se tetiva, znaš, i upucao sam ga.

parovi.en: And who should burst from the trees but the Young Lion and a crowd of his bastards. They reined in so Stour and his lot were sneering bitter scorn from one side of the yard, Brock and his lot scowling righteous outrage on the other. Seemed the Young Lion hadn’t reached the point where tragedies became chores. If anything, he tended towards too much feeling.
parovi.hr: I tko bi drugi izbio iz šume nego Mladi Lav i gomila njegove kopiladi. Zaustavili su konje tako da su Staur i njegova družina podrugljivo širili gorki prezir s jedne strane dvorišta, dok su Brok i njegovi namrgođeno iskazivali pravednički gnjev s druge. Činilo se kako Mladi Lav još nije dosegnuo točku u kojoj tragedije postaju obveze. Štoviše, naginjao je tomu da previše osjeća.

parovi.en: His turn to wrench his horse around and ride off, showering everyone with dirt. Dancer stared at the ground. Prettyboy frowned bitterly at his bow. The fat one set to sobbing again. The corpses, naturally, were unmoved.
parovi.hr: Dođe red na njega da okrene svoga konja i odjaše prskajući sve oko sebe zemljom. Danser je zurio u tlo. Lijepi se gorko namrštio gledajući u svoj Arch. Debeljko ponovo navali jecati. Leševi, posve prirodno, ostadoše nepomični.

parovi.en: “Your August Majesty!” gushed the mayor as Orso’s party approached, collapsing in a bow so low his chain of office feathered the cobbles. “I cannot find the words to describe the privilege of hosting you! The honour for me and the entire town of Stoffenbeck is quite indescribable.”
parovi.hr: — Vaše Uzvišeno Visočanstvo! prosu gradonačelnik dok se Orsova pratnja približavala, spuštajući se u naklon toliko dubok da mu je službeni lanac dotaknuo kaldrmu. „Ne nalazim riječi kojima bih opisao privilegij da vas ugošćujemo! Čast za mene i cijeli grad Stoffenbeck naprosto je neopisiva.“

parovi.en: “Their first scouts.” Forest rubbed at his grizzled jaw. “Even with the roads in the state they are, their main body should be with us before sunset.”
parovi.hr: — Njihove prve prethodnice. Forest protrlja svoju prosijedu čeljust. — Čak i s obzirom na stanje puteva, njihova glavnina trebala bi stići do nas prije zalaska sunca.

parovi.en: “I told them a tale,” said Vick. “That you’re disorganised and short on men. That Brint has prevented any chance of reinforcements. The Lioness had her doubts, but her husband swallowed it whole, I think.”
parovi.hr: — Ispričala sam im priču, reče Vik. — Da ste neorganizirani i u manjku s ljudima. Da je Brint spriječio svaku mogućnost pojačanja. Lavica je imala sumnji, ali njezin je muž to progutao s udicom i plovkom, čini mi se.

parovi.en: “You’d want a ruthless commander,” said Tunny, considering the hills. “Someone who scares our men more than the enemy.”
parovi.hr: — Trebao bi ti bezobziran zapovjednik, reče Tani zagledan u brda. — Netko tko plaši naše vojnike više nego neprijatelj.

parovi.en: “I would like you to conduct Corporal Tunny and his Steadfast Standard across those fields. Seek out the intrepid Lord Governor of Angland! Seek him out with the most pomp, ceremony and military bluster possible. Tunny, I want your bloody salute to take an hour minimum.”
parovi.hr: — Htio bih da dopratiš despornika Tanija i njegovu Čvrstu zastavu preko tih polja. Potraži neustrašivog lorda namjesnika Englenda! Potraži ga s najviše pompe, ceremonije i vojne buke što je moguće. Tani, želim da tvoj krvavi pozdrav traje minimalno sat vremena.

parovi.en: “Your Grace! My lords of the Open Council! Representatives of the North! I’m Corporal Tunny, standard-bearer to the High King of the Union, His August Majesty King Orso the First. Colonel Gorst, Commander of the Knights of the Body, I believe you all know.”
parovi.hr: — Vaša Milosti! Moji Lords iz Otvorenog vijeća! Predstavnici Sjevera! Ja sam desetnik Tani, stjegonoša Velikog kralja Unije, Njegova Uzvišenog Veličanstva kralja Orsa Prvog. Vjerujem da svi znate pukovnika Gorsta, zapovjednika Tjelohranitelja.

parovi.en: Tunny drew himself up in the saddle to deliver that exhibition of a salute again, then whisked his horse masterfully about and bore the king’s radiant standard back towards Stoffenbeck. You couldn’t deny it was a hell of a flag. Perhaps when this was over it would have to go back to Angland, where it belonged.
parovi.hr: Tani se uspravi u sedlu kako bi ponovno izvio onu paradnu počast, a zatim majstorski okrenu konja i odjaha kraljevski blistavi barjak natrag prema Stoffenbecku. Nisi mogao poreći da je to bila paklena zastava. Možda će se, kad ovo završi, morati vratiti u Englend, kamo je i pripadala.

parovi.en: He found himself wishing that Rikke was there. He loved Savine, but she’d a habit of forcing her opinions on people. A subtle, velvety kind of forcing, but her opinions still. Rikke had a way of cutting through the tangle to the simple heart of things. She’d helped him see what he wanted.
parovi.hr: Uhvati se kako priželjkuje da je Rike tu. Volio je Savin, ali ona je imala naviku nametati svoje mišljenje drugima. Suprotno, baršunasto nametanje, ali ipak njezino mišljenje. Rike je imala dar probiti se kroz zamršeno klupko do same srži stvari. Pomogla mu je sagledati što on zapravo želi.

parovi.en: She winced at the clattering footfalls as Shivers and the rest ran out onto the wooden bridge. A moment she’d seen before, she was almost sure. Seen with the Long Eye. The cloaked man in the gateway fumbled for his sword.
parovi.hr: Trznula se na bat koraka dok su Šivers i ostali istrčavali na drveni most. Prizor koji je već vidjela, u to je bila gotovo sigurna. Vidjela Dugim okom. Muškarac u ogrtaču na ulazu u prolaz spetljano je tražio mač.

parovi.en: He blew a little dust from the top of his egg and his pale eyes rolled up to hers. “I’m saying don’t give me one.”
parovi.hr: On otpuhne malo prašine s vrha jajeta i prebaci svijetle oči prema njoj. — Govorim ti da mi ga ne stvaraš.

parovi.en: “I heard him,” said Rikke. “Guess there might be time for that later. Just a celebratory finger or two. But right now, I’m a little busy stealing your city. Where’s Black Calder?”
parovi.hr: — Čula sam ga, rekla je Rike. — Pretpostavljam da će možda biti vremena za to kasnije. Samo par slavljenih prstiju. Ali sada sam malo zauzeta krađom vašeg grada. Gdje je Blek Kalder?

parovi.en: Rikke nodded towards the gates of the inner wall. The gates with Skarling’s Hall beyond, still tight shut. “So who’s in charge in there?”
parovi.hr: Rike kimnu glavom prema vratima unutarnjega zida. Vratima iza kojih se nalazila Skarlingova dvorana, a koja su i dalje bila čvrsto zatvorena. — Pa tko je onda tamo glavni?

parovi.en: “For the Fates’ sakes, you know I’m good for it.” Orso gave a weary sigh as he dropped into his chair. “But that’s being king. Everyone wants a little piece of you. You’ll find out. If you win.”
parovi.hr: — Bogamu miloga, znaš da sam čovjek od riječi. Orso umorno udahnu i sruši se u stolac. — Ali to ti je to kad si kralj. Svatko bi htio komadić tebe. Saznat ćeš i sam. Ako pobijediš.

parovi.en: “Perhaps,” said Brock coldly, “if you were to dismiss your entire Closed Council and replace them with men of our choosing.”
parovi.hr: — Možda, odvrati hladno Brok, kada bi raspustio cijelo svoje Zatvoreno vijeće i zamijenio ih ljudima po našem izboru.

parovi.en: “Patriots, yes, of course,” said Orso, “but I’m not sure you’ve thought this all the way through. Once the troops go home… what’s to stop me changing my mind?”
parovi.hr: — Patrioti, da, , reče Orso, ali nisam siguran da ste ovo promislili do kraja. Jednom kad vojska ode kući… što me sprečava da se predomislim?

parovi.en: “A bolt of lightning could have struck me no more forcefully than when she said no,” mused Orso, chopping at his fish with the side of his fork. “But… perhaps she found another way to make herself queen? I hear she is with you on campaign. She always did like to keep a close eye on her investments.”
parovi.hr: — Munja me nije mogla snažnije udariti nego kad je rekla ne, razmišljao je Orso, režući ribu rubom vilice. — Ali… možda je pronašla drugi način da postane kraljica? Čujem da je s tobom u pohodu. Uvijek je voljela imati na oku svoja ulaganja.

parovi.en: He was half-hard by the time she got his nightshirt up. She kept kissing him, one hand between her legs, one hand between his. Someone has to do the work, after all.
parovi.hr: Bila je polutvrda kad je skidala njegovu košulju za spavanje. Nastavila ga je ljubiti, jedna ruka između njezinih nogu, druga između njegovih. Netko mora obaviti posao, na kraju.

parovi.en: “This one a little to the left, I think,” said Pike, then walked up to the summit of the hill to stand beside Vick, staring out at the valley. “We have been experimenting in the Far Country for several years now.” He watched the crews drag brush around the maws of the great iron tubes to hide them from sight. “And have found that cannons are like birthday presents. Best kept as a surprise.”
parovi.hr: — Ovaj malo ulijevo, rekao bih, odvrati Pajk, a zatim se popeo na vrh brijega kako bi stao pored Vik, zagledan u dolinu. — Već nekoliko godina eksperimentiramo u Dalekoj Zemlji. Promatrao je posade kako vuku grane oko otvora velikih željeznih cijevi kako bi ih sakrili od pogleda. — I otkrili smo da su topovi poput rođendanskih poklona. Najbolje ih je držati u tajnosti.

parovi.en: “I find reputations rarely fit people all that well. What are they, after all, but costumes we put on to disguise ourselves?” The mottled skin above his hairless brows twitched as he gave her uniform a glance. “Costumes we are forced to put on. If men are to be productive, they must have something to fear. That is why we have an Inquisition. I like to tell myself that every life I have taken has saved five more. Fifty more, perhaps. Not everyone has the stomach for that kind of arithmetic.” His
parovi.hr: — Smatram da ugled rijetko doista odgovara ljudima. Što su oni, naposljetku, nego kostimi koje odijevamo da bismo se skrili? Prošarana koža iznad njegovih obrvâ bez dlaka zatreperila je dok je bacio pogled na njezinu odoru. — Kostimi koje smo primorani nositi. Ako ljudi žele biti produktivni, moraju se nečega bojati. Zato i imamo Inkviziciju. Volim si utuviti u glavu da je svaki život koji sam oduzeo spasio još pet. Možda pedeset. Nema svatko želudac za takvu matematiku. Oči su mu zasjale na svj

parovi.en: “Well, we’ve got no walls to climb,” said Bannerman, “so I’ll take a sword, thanks all the same.” And he drew a few inches of his own blade, then slapped it back into its sheath.
parovi.hr: — Pa, mi nemamo zidine koje treba penjati, dometnu Banerman, tako da ću ja uzeti mač, hvala lijepo u svakom slučaju. I izvukao je nekoliko centimetara vlastite oštrice, a zatim je ponovno gurnuo natrag u korice.

parovi.en: He twitched a curtain back to watch those men marching past. Probably he should have been moved by their loyalty. His father would have flapped a half-clenched fist around and trotted out some patriotic platitude. But Orso found himself wondering what strange combination of doubts and desires compelled each individual to subsume themselves into this metal mass, plodding towards their own destruction rather than making the eminently sensible choice to run like hell the other way.
parovi.hr: Zastor pomaknu u stranu kako bi promatrao one vojnike što su marširali mimo. Vjerojatno su ga trebala dirnuti njihova odanost. Njegov otac mahao bi polustisnutom šakom i izbacivao kakve domoljubne općepoznate istine. No Orso se zapita koja čudna mješavina sumnji i želja nagoni svakog pojedinca da se utopi u toj čeličnoj masi i klipsa ususret vlastitom uništenju umjesto da donese krajnje razumnu odluku i pobjegne glavom bez obzira na drugu stranu.

parovi.en: Mostly that he was bored and he wanted to fight someone, Clover imagined, and there’d been no one big enough within arm’s reach.
parovi.hr: Uglavnom to da mu je dosadno i da se želi s nekim potući, pomislio je Klover, a na dohvat ruke nije bilo nikoga dovoljno krupnog.

parovi.en: Barezin gave a cavalier salute, caught hold of his saddle horn, bounced a couple of times and then, with some subtle shoving from one of his aides, hauled himself up and turned his mount towards the west.
parovi.hr: Barezin mu domahne s viteškim prezirom, uhvati se za sedlenu kvrgu, poskoči nekoliko puta i zatim se, uz prikriveno guranje jednog od svojih pobočnika, nekako ispetlja gore i okrene konja prema zapadu.

parovi.en: The forces of the Open Council were gathered on the far left. Yellow blocks, red blobs, blue wedges, bright flags streaming overhead. Their wondrous variety suggested a lack of coordination, but also spoke strongly to the breadth of the coalition against him.
parovi.hr: Snage Otvorenog Vijeća bile su okupljene posve na lijevoj strani. Žuti blokovi, crvene mrlje, plavi klinovi, jarke zastave što su lepršale visoko iznad njih. Ta je šarolika raznolikost ukazivala na manjak koordinacije, ali i glasno svjedočila o širini koalicije uperene protiv njega.

parovi.en: “Alas, the younger generation refuses to honour the debts of the older. The debts that put them where they are. My master will ensure there is a reckoning, depend on that.”
parovi.hr: — Nažalost, mlađa generacija odbija ispoštovati dugove starije. Dugove koji su ih doveli ondje gdje jesu. Moj gospodar pobrinut će se da uslijedi naplata, budite uvjereni u to.

parovi.en: Orso laughed so hard he snorted sherry out of his nose, had to submit to a dabbing down by his footman while he continued to helplessly giggle.
parovi.hr: Orso se tako glasno nasmija da mu je šeri grunuo iz nosa, te je morao trpjeti brisanje koje mu je priredio sobar dok se i dalje nemoćno kikotao.

parovi.en: “How could I sit through this?” snapped Savine, standing with jaw, fists and bladder clenched in a paralysis of helpless fury.
parovi.hr: — Kako bih mogla sjediti i gledati ovo? kresnu Savin stojeći stisnute čeljusti, šaka i mjehura u paralizi bespomoćnog bijesa.

parovi.en: “Cannon will fire in order from my right,” he roared, holding up his fist, “and continue firing until the order is given to cease!”
parovi.hr: — Topovi će opaliti redom s moje desne strane, zaurlao je, podižući stisnutu šaku, i nastaviti paljbu dok se ne izdade zapovijed za prekid!

parovi.en: Clover winced. What the hell Stour planned to do with a hill in the middle of Midderland was anyone’s guess. Graze sheep on it? But the Great Wolf wanted it. So that was that.
parovi.hr: Klover se trgnu. Bog sveti zna što je Staur namjeravao s brdom usred Miderlanda. Pasti ovce na njemu? Ali Veliki Vuk ga je htio. Prema tome, stvar je bila jasna.

parovi.en: The plan had been so simple. How could it have come apart so badly? Confusion in combat was one thing, but he’d lost control of his army before they’d made the slightest contact with the enemy. He stared over at the Open Council’s self-inflicted chaos on the right, then at Stour’s self-inflicted chaos on the left, then at the earthworks straight ahead. He took a long breath.
parovi.hr: Plan je bio tako jednostavan. Kako se mogao tako loše raspasti? Zbrka u borbi bila je jedno, ali izgubio je kontrolu nad vojskom prije nego što su ostvarili i najmanji kontakt s neprijateljem. Zagledao se u kaos što su ga pripadnici Otvoreno Councila sami sebi stvorili s desne strane, potom u Staurov samonametnuti kaos s lijeve, pa u utvrde ravno pred sobom. Duboko je udahnuo.

parovi.en: “Lord Steebling owns most of this land,” said Savine through gritted teeth. “Leo says we’re here to support his rights, not to take them away.”
parovi.hr: — Lord Steebling posjeduje većinu ove zemlje, prozborila je Savin stisnutih zuba. — Leo kaže da smo ovdje kako bismo podržali njegova prava, a ne da mu ih oduzmemo.

parovi.en: He slid the warhammer from his belt and felt the steel haft tight in his grip. Fit there, like a key in a lock. He bared his teeth and walked faster.
parovi.hr: Izvukao je ratni čekić iz pojasa i osjetio kako mu čelična drška čvrsto leži u stisku. Pristajala mu je ondje poput ključa u bravi. Ogolio je zube i ubrzao korak.

parovi.en: Like the Arch Lector, standing in his pure white coat on the summit of the hill. That hard-faced woman, too. Most frightening pair o’ bastards he ever saw. Looked like they never felt a human thing between ’em. He swallowed as he glanced away, swabbed the cannon down and left it steaming.
parovi.hr: Poput Arhilektora, koji je stajao u svom snježnobijelom kaputu na vrhu brda. I ona žena oštra lica. Najstrašniji par gadova što ih je ikad vidio. Izgledali su kao da nikad u životu nisu osjetili ništa čovječno. Progutao je knedlu i odvratio pogled, oprao top i ostavio ga da se puši.

parovi.en: He turned over and shuffled through a slurry of fallen fruit to a twisted tree trunk where several other Kantics were sheltering, along with a Union man in the oddest uniform, half-green, half-brown. He realised as he got close that the man was dead, and the brown half was blood from his arm, which was utterly mangled. He pushed the corpse away with his shoe and wriggled into the place it had occupied, and did not even feel ashamed at his mistreatment of the dead.
parovi.hr: Okrenuo se i oteturao kroz kašu od opalog voća do iskrivljena debla stabla pod kojim se sklanjalo nekoliko drugih Kantika, zajedno s Unijinim vojnikom u najčudnovatijoj odori, napola zelenoj, napola smeđoj. Kad se primaknuo, shvatio je da je čovjek mrtav, a ona smeđa polovina zapravo bijaše krv iz njegove ruke, koja je bila strašno unakažena. Odgurnuo je leš cipelom i ugurao se na mjesto koje je ovaj dotad zauzimao, ne osjećajući ni trunku srama zbog svoga nepoštovanja prema mrtvima.

parovi.en: He shoved a low branch aside and was out from among the trees. Things were no less confused in the open. Dead and wounded everywhere. One dissolving unit was half moving forward, half back, breaking open in the middle and scattering yellow-jacketed men in every direction. A riderless horse frisked maddened through the chaos, empty stirrups bouncing at its flanks.
parovi.hr: Odgurnuo je nisku granu i izbio iz šikare. Na čistini nije ništa manje vladao kaos. Mrtvi i ranjeni ležali su posvuda. Jedna se razbijena postrojba napola kretala naprijed, napola natrag, pucajući po sredini i rasipajući vojnike u žutim jaknama na sve strane. Konj bez jahača mahnito je jurišao kroz metež, dok su mu prazni stremeni udarali o bokove.

parovi.en: “Damn it,” he whispered, giving his horse a moment to rest and easing his helmet back to wipe his sweaty forehead.
parovi.hr: — Prokletstvo, prošaptao je, dopustivši konju da malo odmori i pomaknuvši kacigu unatrag kako bi obrisao znojno čelo.

parovi.en: “Shoot!” said that arsehole of a lieutenant, and Canlan pulled the trigger, and put his bolt in the air, and straight away set to cranking his bow again.
parovi.hr: — Paljba! reče onaj poručnik kreten, a Canlan povuče obarač, posla strijelu u zrak i odmah iznova prionu na navijanje luka.

parovi.en: “Come on! Come on!” snapped that bastard beside him. Everyone had started growling, snarling, grunting, steeling themselves for the slow contact, and the tips of their pikes clicked against the tips of the enemy’s, and the shafts met, and scraped, and slid, closer and closer. A thicket of them, slipping and knocking against each other, and deadly metal on the end.
parovi.hr: — Ajmo! Ajmo! kresnuo je onaj gad pored njega. Svi su počeli režati, siktati, hroptati, čeličeći se za polagan sudar, a vrhovi njihovih pika zveckali su o vrhove neprijateljskih, i držači su se sudarali, strugali i klizili, sve bliže i bliže. Gustiš od njih, koji se klizao i udarao jedan o drugi, s ubojitim metalom na kraju.

parovi.en: He gave a snarl through his gritted teeth when it pricked him. Just a cold pinch, and then a biting, and a worse, and his snarl got higher and higher until it was a desperate, slobbering shriek, an impossible, unbearable pain cutting through his chest.
parovi.hr: Proizveo je režanje kroz stisnute zube kad ga je ubola. Bio je to tek hladan štipalj, a onda ugriz, pa još gori, a njegovo režanje postajalo je sve više dok se nije pretvorilo u očajnički, slinavi vrisak, u nemoguću, nepodnošljivu bol koja mu je sjekla prsa.

parovi.en: “Up we get,” grunted Scalla, pulling the wounded man off her and dumping him onto the stretcher. She’d almost complained when she first saw how rough he was with them. Like he was hefting sacks of coal. She’d soon learned that delicacy did no one any good. She stumbled to the foot of the stretcher, caught hold of the handles. Scalla had undone the buckle on the wounded man’s helmet and tossed it bouncing away, turned around to grab his handles and looked over his shoulder to meet her eye. “One,
parovi.hr: — Diži se, protisnu Scalla, zbacivši ranjenika sa sebe i istovarivši ga na nosila. Skoro se pobunila kad je prvi put vidjela koliko je grub prema njima. Kao da diže vreće ugljena. Ubrzo je naučila da nježnost nikome ne koristi. Posrnula je prema podnožju nosila, uhvatila se za ručke. Scalla je otkopčala kopču na kacigi ranjenika i hitnula je, a ona je odskočila u daljinu, okrenula se da dohvati svoje ručke i preko njegovog ramena susrela njezin pogled. — Jedan, dva…

parovi.en: Wanting to prove she was useful. Wanting to prove she was brave. She was the one always carried messages for Orso, so she’d carry this one. Realised her mistake soon as she ran from the town hall and into the madness in the street. She’d hated carrying Orso’s messages to that bitch Savine dan Glokta. Her affected elegance and her gaudy taste and her superior little smirks. But Hildi’s chances of getting killed carrying love letters had been very small.
parovi.hr: Želeći dokazati da je korisna. Želeći dokazati da je hrabra. Ona je uvijek nosila Orsove poruke, pa će ponijeti i ovu. Shvatila je svoju pogrešku čim je istrčala iz gradske vijećnice u ludilo na ulici. Mrzila je nositi Orsove poruke onoj kučki Savin dan Glokta. Njezinoj izvještačenoj eleganciji i kičastom ukusu te njezinim superiornim malim podsmjesima. No Hildine šanse da bude ubijena noseći ljubavna pisma bile su vrlo male.

parovi.en: She gave the corporal almost as hard a shove as he’d given her, then nearly tripped over a corpse just behind him. A Northman’s corpse, fur around his shoulders matted with blood. He wasn’t alone. Lots of bodies, left where they fell.
parovi.hr: Odgurnula je desetnika gotovo jednako snažno kao što je on nju, a onda se umalo spotaknula o leš koji je ležao neposredno iza njega. Sjevernjački leš, s krznom oko ramena zamršenim od krvi. Nije bio sam. Mnoštvo tijela, ostavljenih ondje gdje su pala.

parovi.en: Always thought he’d be one of the brave ones. Congratulated himself on it when he was doing his jacket up that morning. You’re one of the brave ones, Stillman!
parovi.hr: Uvijek je mislio da će biti jedan od hrabrih. Čestitao si je na tome dok je zakopčavao jaknu tog jutra. Ti si jedan od hrabrih, Stillmane!

parovi.en: They were like phrases in a foreign tongue. How could anyone be steady with red-handed murder rushing up the hill towards them? How could anyone be steady with the Northmen’s horrible yells, and the screams of dying comrades, and the endless clatter of metal, the thunder of the distant cannons echoing shrill in their ears?
parovi.hr: Zvučalo mu je to poput riječi na nekom stranom jeziku. Kako je ikad mogao ostati priseban dok im se krvavo ubojstvo žurilo uz brdo? Kako je tko mogao ostati miran uz strašne ratne pokliče Sjevernjaka, krikove umirućih suboraca i neprekidno zveckanje metala, uz grmljavinu dalekih topova što mu je prodorno odzvanjala u ušima?

parovi.en: “Die, bastard, fucking die, bastard,” every breath a flood of curses, and he hacked at a shield and put a great scar through the sun pattern on it, hacked at it again and knocked the man holding it over on his back, hacked at his leg and left his foot flopping off by a flap of gristle.
parovi.hr: — Crkni, gade, jebi se, crkni, gade, svaki mu je udah bio prepun psovki, usjekao se u štit i ostavio veliku ogrebotinu preko sunčeva motiva na njemu, udario ga ponovo i oborio čovjeka koji ga je držao na leđa, rasjekao mu nogu i ostavio stopalo da visi na komadu hrskavice.

parovi.en: “A cannon-stone must have clipped one of those lovely chimneys. A sad loss to posterity…” He brushed a few specks of plaster from his shoulder plate. Pauldron, was that the word? Or vambrace? He got them mixed up.
parovi.hr: — Topovsko đule moralo je okrznuti jedan od onih divnih dimnjaka. Tužan gubitak za potomstvo… — Otresao je nekoliko zrnaca žbuke s ramenog oklopa. Ramenjača, je li to bila riječ? Ili podlaktica? Miješao ih je.

parovi.en: “Damn it.” Orso would never forgive himself if anything happened to Hildi. “What about Lord Marshal Rucksted? Any sign?”
parovi.hr: — Prokletstvo. Orso si nikada ne bi oprostio da se Hildi nešto dogodilo. — Što je s lordom maršalom Ruckstedom? Ima li kakvih tragova?

parovi.en: Gurkish Fire had left a stinking black scar through the grass, shrouding the summit in smoke as the rain started to spit down. Below, she could see the troops of the Open Council slogging steadily up the hillside under drooping flags. They were battered by cannon fire, sodden from the river, exhausted from the climb. But they were coming, and in numbers.
parovi.hr: Gurkička vatra ostavila je smrdljiv, crn ožiljak na travi, obavivši vrh brda dimom dok je kiša počinjala rominjati. Dolje je mogla vidjeti postrojbe Otvorenoga vijeća kako se postojano penju uz padinu pod obješenim zastavama. Bile su izudarane topovskom vatrom, promočene od rijeke, iznurene usponom. Ali dolazile su, i to u gomili.

parovi.en: Savine stared, mouth open in disbelief as, with awful, nerve-shredding slowness, all her ambitions came apart at the seams.
parovi.hr: Savin je zapanjeno promatrala otvorenih usta dok su joj se, uz užasnu, živce parajuću sporost, sve ambicije raspadale po šavovima.

parovi.en: “I noticed,” said Leo, watching in helpless fury as the Open Council’s forces crumbled and fled for the river.
parovi.hr: — Primijetio sam, odvrati Leo, promatrajući s bespomoćnim gnjevom kako se snage Otvorenog vijeća rasipaju i bježe prema rijeci.

parovi.en: Leo could see exhausted men floundering from the river on the near bank. Across the water, the King’s Own cavalry surged and whirled like the starlings above the field the day before, harrying the panicked remnants of the Open Council’s forces. Corpses floated downstream, clogged into a great bobbing tangle in the boggy shallows.
parovi.hr: Leo je mogao vidjeti iscrpljene ljude kako se gegaju iz rijeke na bližoj obali. Preko vode, kraljeva osobna konjica navaljivala je i kovitlala se poput čvoraka iznad polja prethodnog dana, goneći uspaničene ostatke snaga Otvorenog vijeća. Leševi su plovili nizvodno, nakupljeni u veliku zapetljanu gomilu u močvarnim plićacima.

parovi.en: Now at a jolting canter, hooves drumming as the Young Lion’s cavalry charged into battle once again. A battle ill-suited to horsemen, though, it had to be admitted. Leo never seemed to learn where that was concerned.
parovi.hr: Sada u poskakujućem galopu, kopita su bubnjala dok je konjica Mlađeg Lava još jednom jurišala u bitku. Bitku posve neprikladnu za konjanike, doduše, moralo se priznati. Činilo se da Leo to nikako ne uspijeva naučiti.

parovi.en: The cavalry had thundered through and torn the lines apart. Ripped them into shreds of bitter fighting, tattered struggles to the death, writhing in the smoke. Broad saw the blobbed shapes of three men shaken loose. King’s men, he thought. Deserters, maybe. That was his best guess. In a battle, a guess is all you can afford. Time to let go, finally, and he felt the smile twist his face.
parovi.hr: Kroz sve to prohujala je konjica i rastrgala redove. Raznijela ih u dronjke ogorčena ratovanja, iskidane bitke na život i smrt, uz nemirno previjanje u dimu. Brod je ugledao zagasite obrise trojice ljudi koji su se odvojili od gomile. Kraljevi ljudi, pomislio je. Dezerteri, možda. To je bila njegova najbolja procjena. U bitci se drugo ne može ni tražiti. Krajnje je vrijeme da se konačno prepusti, i osjetio je kako mu osmijeh iskrivljuje lice.

parovi.en: Broad charged into the very midst of it, caught a man full in the side with his shoulder and dumped him sprawling, sword bouncing from his hand. He reeled into someone else, spear clattering against Broad’s back as he swung, too close for the hammer and Broad stabbed with his knife, overhand. It scraped on a breastplate, scratched down an armplate, found the joint between the two and punched deep into flesh. The man tried to twist away, fumbling at Broad’s shoulder, and Broad rammed the dagger t
parovi.hr: Brod je jurnuo u samu sredinu toga meteža, ramenom pokosio čovjeka u bok i bacio ga na tlo, dok mu je mač ispao iz ruke i odskočio. Posrnuo je na nekog drugog, Pajk mu je udarilo o leđa dok se okretao, preblizu za malj, pa je Brod ubo nožem, odozgo. Ostrugao je o prsni oklop, zarezao naramenicu, našao spoj između dvaju oklopa i duboko se zario u meso. Čovjek se pokušao izmaknuti, pipajući po Brodovu ramenu, a Brod mu je zabio bodež kroz otvor na kacigi, ostavivši ga ondje zabijenog do drške dok

parovi.en: Last stand wasn’t a phrase you ever wanted to use about your own side, but that was the look of it. Wounded men. Twisted faces. Desperate shouting. Someone coughed, leaning on a broken spear, coughing blood, and drooling blood, coughing again. The Northman, Jin, had a flatbow bolt in his thigh. He had Brock under the armpits even so, swearing in Northern as he struggled to drag him out from under his dead mount.
parovi.hr: Posljednji otpor nije bila fraza koju bi išta poželio upotrijebiti za svoju stranu, ali tako je izgledalo. Ranjeni ljudi. Izobličena lica. Očajničko vikanje. Netko se zakašljao, oslanjajući se na slomljeno Pajk, kašljući krv i balaveći krv, pa se ponovno zakašljao. Sjevernjak, Jin, imao je strelicu samostrela u bedru. Ipak je držao Broka ispod pazuha, psujući na sjevernjačkom dok se mučio izvući ga ispod njegovog mrtvog konja.

parovi.en: It was bad now. It was always bad, but it was real bad now. Everyone on the arrow-prickled, blood-smeared, mud-churned way was hurt. A Carl spluttered blood and bits of teeth into his hands. Another stared stupidly, hair clotted with blood. A Thrall clutched at the leaking stumps of two fingers, snarling curses. A Named Man sat, pale as milk, staring down at his hands as he tried to poke his guts back in through a great slit in his side. Clover caught his eye and gave him a nod. He was back to t
parovi.hr: Bilo je loše. Uvijek je bilo loše, ali sad je bilo zbilja loše. Svi na putu posijanom strijelama, uprljanom krvlju i razrovanom blatom bili su ozlijeđeni. Karl je ispljunuo krv i komadiće zuba u ruke. Dugi je tupo zurio, slijepljene kose natopljene krvlju. Tral je stiskao krvave patrljke dvaju prstiju režući psovke. Čovjek s Imenom sjedio je blijed poput krpe i zurio u vlastite ruke dok je pokušavao ugurati crijeva natrag kroz veliku rasjekotinu na boku. Klover ga pogleda u oči i kimne mu. Vrati

parovi.en: Downside’s eyes rolled slowly up, as if even that was too much effort, one turned bright red by a blow to the face and his cheek cut and his forehead scuffed raw and his brow opened up and weeping a dark streak.
parovi.hr: Daunsajdove se oči polako zakotrljaše prema gore, kao da je i to bilo previše truda; jedno mu je oko bilo jarkocrveno od udarca u lice, obraz rasječen, čelo izgrebano do krvi, a arkada rasklimana, pa je iz nje curio taman mlaz.

parovi.en: “’Course not,” said Clover. “But he might back off when it suits him, specially from another man’s fight. Wouldn’t be our victory. Won’t be our defeat.” He leaned close. “The Young Lion dug this fucking hole. He can be the one buried in it.”
parovi.hr: — Kako da ne, odvrati Klover. — Ali mogao bi se povući kad mu to odgovara, pogotovo iz tuđe bitke. To ne bi bila naša pobjeda. Neće biti ni naš poraz. Primače se posve blizu. — Mladi Lav je iskopao ovu jebenu rupu. Neka bude onaj koji će u njoj i završiti.

parovi.en: Leo used his sword like a crutch, weight all on his good leg, which an hour ago had been his bad leg. It hardly seemed to hurt at all now. Not compared to the other one, crushed by his horse. Not compared to his dangling arm, riddled with bits of steel from a cannon.
parovi.hr: Leo se oslonio na mač kao na štaku, sav se oslonivši na zdravu nogu — onu koja mu je još prije sat vremena bila ozlijeđena. Sada je jedva osjećao bol. Barem ne u usporedbi s drugom, koju mu je smrskao konj. Ni u usporedbi s visećom rukom, izbušenom komadićima čelika iz topa.

parovi.en: “Good, good. I hear Black Calder’s gone off to suck some cocks up in the High Valleys and left you holding the baby. That right?”
parovi.hr: — Dobro, dobro. Čujem da je Blek Kalder otišao pušiti kurce gore u Visoke doline i ostavio tebe da držiš ljestve. Je li tako?

parovi.en: She thought of the first time she saw a man killed. Those three she and Isern ran into in the woods the day Uffrith burned. Was it really only a year or two back? The cold shock as she let go the bowstring. The hurt look in that boy’s eyes. Still gave her a shiver. Then she thought of all the death she’d seen since. The murders and the battles and the duels. The last expressions, the last words, the last breaths, all blurred into one. The blood rolled off her now, like milk off a greased pan. Is
parovi.hr: Sjetila se prvoga puta kad je vidjela kako ubijaju čovjeka. Onu trojicu na koje su ona i Izern naišle u šumi onoga dana kad je Afrit izgorio. Je li doista prošlo tek godinu ili dvije? Hladan šok kad je otpustila tetivu. Povrijeđen pogled u očima toga dječaka. Od toga bi se još uvijek naježila. Zatim je pomislila na svu silu smrti kojoj je svjedočila od tada. Ubojstva, bitke i dvoboje. Posljednji izrazi lica, posljednje riječi, posljednji uzdasi, sve se to stopilo u jedno. Krv je sada klizila s n

parovi.en: “Some will be,” said Rikke. “But if King Orso took any notice of the letter I sent him, they’ll have a much harder fight than they were expecting. So Stour’ll come back with a lot fewer warriors than you were expecting. If he comes back at all.”
parovi.hr: — Neki hoće, reče Rike. — Ali ako je kralj Orso obratio ikakvu pažnju na pismo koje sam mu poslala, imat će mnogo težu borbu nego što su očekivali. Stoga će se Staur vratiti s mnogo manje ratnika nego što ti očekuješ. Ako se uopće vrati.

parovi.en: Shivers had his eye on Skarling’s Chair. “Trouble with being a strong man or a clever man with a big, bad name,” he said, and he ought to know, after all, “is that folk always have their best fight ready for you.”
parovi.hr: Šivers je motrio Skarlingovu stolicu. — problem s tim kad si snažan ili mudar čovjek s velikim, zlim imenom" – a on je to, zaboga, trebao znati – "jest u tome što narod uvijek čuva svoju najbolju borbu baš za tebe.

parovi.en: Rucksted frowned towards the rocky bluff, where yesterday’s cannons still poked from the hill like the prongs of an iron crown. “The world’s changing, that’s for damn sure. Now a man can put a spark to some powder and a thousand strides away another man’s blown limb from limb. There was a time you had to look in his eyes, at least.”
parovi.hr: Rucksted se namrštio prema stjenovitoj litici, s koje su jučerašnji topovi i dalje virili iz brda poput zubaca željezne kune. — Svijet se mijenja, to je prokleto sigurno. Sada čovjek može kresnuti iskru u malo baruta i tisuću koraka dalje drugom čovjeku raznijeti udove. Bilo je vrijeme kada si ga morao pogledati u oči, barem tada.

parovi.en: “Stour Nightfall himself is unaccounted for,” said Pike. “I fear we may not have heard his name for the last time.”
parovi.hr: — Sam Staur Najtfol još nije pronađen, primijeti Pajk. — Bojim se da njegovo ime nismo čuli posljednji put.

parovi.en: “This is all a misunderstanding, Your Majesty!” one young lordling spluttered, face pressed so hard against the bars they left livid marks in the flesh to either side. “All a terrible misunderstanding!”
parovi.hr: — Ovo je strašan nesporazum, Vaše Visočanstvo! procijedi mladi plemić prislonivši lice tako čvrsto uz rešetke da su na mesu ostali ljubičasti tragovi s objiju strana. — Sve je to strašan nesporazum!

parovi.en: Gorst lowered his eyes and trudged from the room, pulling the door shut. When Orso turned back, Brock had a pained grimace on his face.
parovi.hr: Brok je otvorio usta. Potom je uz bolnu grimasu slegnuo ramenima, ispustio jauk patnje i klonuo. — Je li to uopće važno?

parovi.en: Witty back and forth, as if they were discussing business on an ordinary day rather than hiding in a muddy hollow under the roots of a fallen tree, with everything in utter ruins. Savine wrapped her arms around herself, wrapped her arms around her baby and felt it move, thank the Fates. Her shoulder, her side, her neck were one great stiff throb where she must have hit the ground. She could easily have been dead.
parovi.hr: Duhovito nabacivanje riječima, kao da raspravljaju o poslu za obična dana, a ne se skrivaju u blatnjavoj udolini pod korijenjem oborenog stabla, dok je sve oko njih u potpunim ruševinama. Savin obgrli ruke oko sebe, obgrli ruke oko svog djeteta i osjeti kako se pomiče, hvala Sudbini. Rame, bok, vrat — sve ju je užasno, tupo boljelo ondje gdje je morala udariti o tlo. Lako je mogla biti mrtva.

parovi.en: “It’s my only chance to save myself. We have no supplies. The king’s forces are everywhere. My entourage is down to two and it’s two more than I deserve. We’ll never make it to the coast. Not with me the size of a house.”
parovi.hr: — To mi je jedina šansa da spasim sebe. Nemamo zaliha. Kraljeve snage su posvuda. Moja je pratnja spala na dvoje, a to je dvoje više nego što zaslužujem. Nikada nećemo stići do obale. Ne s mojim trbuhom velikim poput kuće.

parovi.en: She felt Zuri’s light hand on one shoulder. “My scripture teacher would no doubt have said…” She was frowning doubtfully out across the battered battlefield. “That regret is the gateway to salvation…”
parovi.hr: Vrata su zveckajući otklizala i ona se trznula tako naglo da joj je leđima prošao grč; umalo je povratila i ostala napola na nogama, oslanjajući se na stolicu jednom drhtavom rukom.

parovi.en: Savine swallowed. She had planned the best way to frame it, how to subtly shift the blame, each word picked out as carefully as an ensemble for the theatre, but now the excuses burbled out in a half-baked rush. “They were already planning it. Isher, and the rest. I had no choice. I could only—”
parovi.hr: Savin proguta knedlu. Bila je isplanirala najbolji način da to sroči, kako suptilno svaliti krivnju, svaka riječ odabrana brižljivo poput kostima za kazalište, ali sad su opravdanja navrla u brzopletomu, polupečenomu mlazu. — Oni su to već planirali. Išer i ostali. Nisam imala izbora. Mogla sam samo —

parovi.en: She could hardly stand. She sank down on her knees. “I’m begging you for mercy. For my husband. For myself. For our child.” Hands clasped, face wet with tears, nose clicking with snot. What a fucking cliché. “I know I don’t deserve it, but it’s all I can do now. Please, Orso.”
parovi.hr: Jedva se držala na nogama. Pala je na koljena. — Preklinjem te za milost. Zbog mog muža. Zbog sebe. Zbog našeg djeteta. Sklopljenih ruku, lica umrljanog suzama, nosa što joj šmrca. Kakav jebeni klišej. — Znam da to ne zaslužujem, ali to je sve što mi je preostalo. Molim te, Orso.

parovi.en: Men scurried about the ship as that distant light grew brighter and was joined to either side by the grey rumour of the coast. Wood clonked, rope hissed and salt spray flew as they brought in the sailcloth and leaned to the oars.
parovi.hr: Ljudi su se užurbano kretali po brodu dok je ono udaljeno svjetlo postajalo sve sjajnije, a s obje mu se strane pridružio sivi obris obale. Drvo je škripalo, konopi su šuštali, a slana je prskavica letjela dok su uvlačili jedro i naginjali se na vesla.

parovi.en: Greenway’s jaw hung open. “What—” And Downside’s axe split his head in half, spraying blood. Seemed Rikke had been right about him dying on the water, and not just him. All over the boat, Clover’s boys stabbed the men beside them, cut throats, smashed skulls, stuck blades in backs and fronts and sides. All done too close and too quiet and too sudden for swords. Just the way Clover always said it should be done. Far faster than when Stour killed Scale and his men. Far neater.
parovi.hr: Grinveju su se usta objesila. — Što–" I Daunsajdova mu je sjekira rascvjetala glavu na pola, špricajući krv. Činilo se da je Rike bila u pravu kad je govorila da će skončati na vodi, i to ne samo on. Posvuda po brodu Kloverovi su momci ubadali ljude do sebe, rezali grkljane, drobili lubanje, zabijali oštrice u leđa, prsa i bokove. Sve se odigralo preblizu, pretiho i prebrzo za mačeve. Baš onako kako je Klover uvijek govorio da treba. Puno brže nego kad je Staur pobio Skejla i njegove ljude. Puno

parovi.en: “You brought him, then,” he said as Clover clambered somewhat ungainly from the ship, wood of the wharf feeling unsteady under his sea legs.
parovi.hr: — Doveli ste ga, dakle, reče dok se Klover nekako nespretno ispeo s broda, a drvo gata činilo mu se nestabilnim pod njegovim mornarskim nogama.

parovi.en: “What’re you doing?” he squealed, twisting and struggling, but Downside had him under one arm now and the Nail under the other and he wasn’t going far with them two holding on.
parovi.hr: — Što radiš? zacvili, vrteći se i praćakajući, ali Daunsajd ga je već držao pod jednom rukom, a Čavao pod drugom, i nije mogao daleko s tom dvojicom na sebi.

parovi.en: He gave a whoop as his crutch slipped on the top step and spun from his hand. He clutched at nothing, then the side of his face banged hard into the platform. He heard a few gasps, a whimper from somewhere. Maybe him.
parovi.hr: Glasno je uzdahnuo kad mu se štaka okliznula na gornjoj stubi i izletjela mu iz ruke. Mahnuo je u prazno, a zatim se bočnom stranom lica snažno udario o platformu. Čuo je nekoliko uzdaha, nečiji prigušeni jecaj. Možda njegov vlastiti.

parovi.en: Was there dried blood on the rope? He felt vaguely affronted by that. For something so intimate, each person should surely get their own. Felt like dying in another man’s underwear. Though the underwear of those who’d gone ahead was no doubt in a far worse state. People pissed and shat and leaked every fluid when they were hanged, he knew. It had seemed quite a laugh when Antaup told them all about it over drinks. Didn’t seem much of a laugh now, needless to say.
parovi.hr: Je li na užetu bila suha krv? To ga je nekako vrijeđalo. Za nešto toliko intimno, svatko bi jamačno trebao dobiti svoje. Činilo se to kao umiranje u tuđem donjem rublju. Iako je donje rublje onih koji su prošli prije nesumnjivo bilo u puno gorem stanju. Ljudi pišaju, kake i puštaju svaku tekućinu kad ih vješaju, to je znao. Činilo se to prilično smiješnim kad im je Antaup sve to ispričao uz piće. Sad se to, nepotrebno je reći, više nije činilo tako smiješnim.

parovi.en: There were even different kinds of silence. An obstinate refusal to speak. A baffled inability to understand what was happening. A lip-trembling, stuttering, quivering fear.
parovi.hr: Postojale su čak i različite vrste tišine. Tvrdoglavo odbijanje govora. Zatečena nesposobnost shvaćanja onoga što se događa. Strah koji trese usne, izaziva mucanje i ledi krv u žilama.

parovi.en: Leo flinched as Mustred dropped with a clatter and a thud, and a set of crows that had gathered on the bare beams of a fallen roof flapped outraged into the sky.
parovi.hr: Leo se trgnuo kad je Mustred propao uz tresak i tupi udar, a jato vrana okupljenih na golim gredama srušena krova uzbuđeno i uzrujano prhnulo u nebo.

parovi.en: The next man swooned, knees giving and dropping to the platform. One of the executioners dragged him up, slapped his hooded face, stood him straight on his trapdoor. Clatter and thud as he dropped.
parovi.hr: Sljedeći se čovjek onesvijestio, koljena su mu klecnula te je pao na platformu. Jedan ga je dželat povukao gore, udario mu šamar po licu u kapuljači i uspravio ga ravno na njegovu trapulu. Tutnjava i prasak dok je propao.

parovi.en: And Leo felt the noose loosened, then slipped over his head. As if that had been the only thing holding him up, he slumped, crutch clattering down. The executioner was ready and caught him, lowered him to the platform.
parovi.hr: I Leo osjeti kako se omča opustila, a zatim skliznula preko njegove glave. Kao da mu je to bila jedina potpora, klonuo je, dok mu je štaka zveckajući pala na tlo. Dželat je bio spreman i uhvatio ga, spustivši ga na podest.

parovi.en: “I meant the prison camps of Angland. I have come to believe… that the heart of a society… is revealed in its prisons.” Pike rocked gently with the movement of his horse, eyes fixed up the empty street ahead. “I was not there nearly as long as you, but long enough to lose my face. Honestly, I was never a handsome man. I daresay I turn more heads now. Your scars may not show quite so clearly, but I never doubt you have them. So I believe I understand you.”
parovi.hr: — Mislio sam na logore Englenda. Uvjerio sam se… da se srce nekog društva… najbolje vidi u njegovim zatvorima. Pajk se lagano njihao u ritmu konjskog kretanja, upirući pogled u praznu ulicu pred sobom. — Nisam bio ondje ni približno dugo kao ti, ali dovoljno dugo da izgubim lice. Iskreno rečeno, nikad nisam bio naočit muškarac. Usudio bih se reći da sad privlačim više pogleda. Tvoji se ožiljci možda ne vide tako jasno, ali nijednog trenutka ne sumnjam da ih imaš. Stoga vjerujem da te razumijem.

parovi.en: “Fuck,” breathed Vick. Not often she was at a loss for words, but right then she had nothing better.
parovi.hr: — Jebi ga, prošaptala je Vik. Rijetko bi ostala bez riječi, ali u tom trenutku nije imala ništa pametnije.

parovi.en: “Three days ago,” said Risinau, rubbing his hands delightedly, “while King Orso was winning his great victory against the rebels. They wanted us to distract the king’s men for them. Instead, they distracted the king’s men for us!”
parovi.hr: — Prije tri dana, reče Risinau zadovoljno trljajući ruke, dok je kralj Orso izvojevao svoju veliku pobjedu nad pobunjenicima. Htjeli su im odvratiti kraljeve ljude. Umjesto toga, oni su odvratili kraljeve ljude za nas!

parovi.en: Vick thought of the long line of hanged men Pike had left outside the city, a few months before. She’d thought him ruthless then. Now it turned out they’d been his own people. A man who’ll waste no time hanging two hundred of his friends… what might he do to his enemies? Smoke was already pouring from the windows of the bank, giving every breath the familiar char and fury stink of Valbeck she so well remembered.
parovi.hr: Vik se sjetila se dugačkog niza obješenih ljudi koje je Pajk ostavio izvan grada nekoliko mjeseci prije. Smatrala ga je nemilosrdnim tada. Sada se pokazalo da su to bili njegovi vlastiti ljudi. Čovjek koji bez oklijevanja objesi dvjesto svojih prijatelja… što bi tek mogao učiniti svojim neprijateljima? Iz prozora banke već je kuljao dim, dajući svakom udahu onaj dobro znani miris paljevine i gnjeva Valbeka kojeg se tako dobro sjećala.

parovi.en: Colonel Forest—a hard-working officer with common origins and impressive scars, commanded the Crown Prince’s Division for Orso.
parovi.hr: Pukovnik Forest — marljivi časnik skromnog podrijetla i impresivnih ožiljaka, zapovijedao je Divizijom prijestolonasljednika za Orsa.
